articleTitle: Isolated Multi-Output Power Supply Based on Forward Converter Using Tertiary Winding
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Recent Trends in Microelectronics, Automation, Computing and Communications Systems (ICMACC)
abstract: This paper presents the design, simulation, and hardware implementation of single input multi-output (SIMO) DC-DC forward converter. The proposed converter is aimed at applications requiring multiple isolated output from a single DC source, which is critical in various industrial and electronic systems. The converter operates with a nominal input voltage of 30 V and delivers three distinct output voltages: 9 V, 24 V, and 12 V. The initial design and performance verification is carried out using LTspice, enabling detailed analysis and optimization of the converter. The hardware implementation is discussed, highlighting the practical aspects of constructing the converter, which includes custom-designed inductors and a high-frequency transformer with five windings.

articleTitle: Implementing a Deep Learning Based Bridge Defect Detection System Using Jetson Nano
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Recent Trends in Microelectronics, Automation, Computing and Communications Systems (ICMACC)
abstract: This work describes the creation and application of an NVIDIA Jetson Nano platform-based deep learning bridge fault detection system. Bridges constitute crucial pieces of infrastructure, and maintaining safety and averting catastrophic failures depend on quick detection of flaws like corrosion, cracks, or structural damage. Conventional inspection techniques can be time-consuming, labor-intensive, and prone to mistakes. Here, we offer a computer vision-based methodology that uses deep learning techniques to automatically identify and categorize bridge structure faults from photos collected with fixed cameras or by drones. Real-time defect detection uses the NVIDIA Jetson Nano as an edge computing device because of its great computational capacity and low power consumption. The three primary phases of the suggested system include preprocessing images, employing convolutional neural networks (CNNs) for fault identification, and post-processing for analysis and visualization. Using the Jetson Nano's GPU acceleration for quick inference, we gathered a dataset of bridge photos with different kinds of flaws and carried out comprehensive tests to assess the system's performance. The suggested method shows efficient covering defects with an accuracy of 96%, while preserving the Jetson Nano platform's real-time processing capabilities.

articleTitle: Deep Learning Approaches for Occlusion Removal in Medical Images
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Recent Trends in Microelectronics, Automation, Computing and Communications Systems (ICMACC)
abstract: Medical imaging is essential for accurate diagnosis and effective treatment planning. However, medical images often suffer from occlusions caused by various factors such as artifacts, noise, or anatomical structures. These occlusions can impede accurate analysis and interpretation, leading to potential misdiagnosis or treatment errors. Addressing occlusion removal in medical images is thus of paramount importance. This work examines the state-of-the-art deep learning techniques for occlusion removal in medical imaging, focusing on convolutional neural networks, autoencoders, and generative adversarial networks (GANs). These models utilize robust feature extraction and reconstruction capabilities to restore occluded regions with high accuracy, preserving critical anatomical structures and pathological details.

articleTitle: Soil Classification Using Deep Learning Techniques
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Recent Trends in Microelectronics, Automation, Computing and Communications Systems (ICMACC)
abstract: The objective of this project is to classify the four types of soil images using deep learning models that is the Convolutional Neural Networks (CNN) and the Artificial Neural Networks (ANN). Each model classifies four types of soils, namely alluvial soil, black soil, red soil, and clay soil using images. The input imagesconsisted of over 1600 images of the above-mentioned soil types, 70% were used for training the model and the remaining 30% were usedas the testing set, prior to model training the transforms module of the pytorch library was used to pre-process the dataset and improve the model generalization by using data wrangling methods to avoid model overfitting. The Pytorch library was used again to create the Neural Network Classes in both the models, and the dask library was used to obtain the distribution of images according to the different soil types. The ANN-based model was then trained and tested until it showed an improvement in accuracy of around 88% to 91%. Similarly, the CNN-based Model was trained until it showed an increase in accuracy of 92% to 96%. The f1 scorecalculated for CNN was 0.9253 and for ANN was 0.9318. Furthermore, the ROC Curves and Confusion Matrix were used from the sklearn metrics library to calculate the accuracy of the predictions made by the models. From the analysis it is interpreted that the Convolutional Neural Network-based Model is the most efficient classifier for image datasets.

articleTitle: Exploring Advanced Image Refinement with Blind Denoising Autoencoder Architecture
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Recent Trends in Microelectronics, Automation, Computing and Communications Systems (ICMACC)
abstract: This project introduces an innovative method for enhancing license plate images by employing a blind autoencoder-based denoising and deblurring technique. Unlike conventional approaches that heavily rely on labeled training data, which can be both scarce and costly to obtain, our method circumvents this requirement. Instead, it leverages a blind autoencoder trained on a vast collection of unlabeled license plate images to effectively denoise and deblur input images. Through evaluation on a standard dataset, our approach demonstrates significant enhancements in peak signal-to-noise ratio (PSNR) and structural similarity index (SSIM) compared to conventional methods.

articleTitle: Federated Deep Learning for Multiclass Sentiment Analysis: Privacy-Preserving CNNs with Optimized Aggregation
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Recent Trends in Microelectronics, Automation, Computing and Communications Systems (ICMACC)
abstract: This research investigates an advanced sentiment classification model using Federated Learning (FL) in conjunction with Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs), concentrating on five sentiment categories: Very Negative, Negative, Neutral, Positive and Very Positive. This paper explores critical concerns about traditional centralized approaches, such as privacy, computational costs, and data heterogeneity. The federated learning-based model attained an average accuracy of 85.7% over five publicly accessible sentiment datasets. This paper's classification examples include IMDB Reviews, Yelp Reviews, news/reviews, Amazon Product Reviews, Twitter, Sentiment140, finance, and news. In this case, the highest classification accuracy was obtained at Amazon product reviews, which stood at 90.1 %. In comparison, the lowest average accuracy was obtained in Twitter Sentiment140 with an accuracy of 82.5 % due to large-scale social media data mess. To enhance the model's accuracy, we employed different aggregation algorithms, which showed an enhanced method known as Weighted Averaging as 3.4% better than the conventional FedAvg, particularly for datasets showing skewed classes. Additionally, performance improvement was observed, where clustered Aggregation increased performance by 2.7% on Yelp Reviews and Finance News Sentiment datasets. Also, the communication overhead was reduced in this work by reducing the communication frequency to every five rounds, which reduced the communication overhead by 15%. In contrast, the accuracy was only reduced by 0.5%. These results prove the effectiveness of the federated learning approach for both sentiment categorization and data privacy and computational and scenario efficiency.

articleTitle: Applications of Machine Learning Techniques for Renewable Resource Management
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Recent Trends in Microelectronics, Automation, Computing and Communications Systems (ICMACC)
abstract: Renewable resource management plays a pivotal role in advancing sustainable development, particularly concerning energy production and utilization. The integration of Artificial Intelligence (AI) and Machine Learning (ML) techniques has significantly bolstered the efficiency and effectiveness of managing renewable resources. This survey paper offers a comprehensive overview of recent advancements in AI and ML applications within the realm of renewable resource management. It delves into areas such as renewable energy prediction, resource allocation, optimization strategies, and decision-making processes. Through this exploration, we aim to dissect various AI and ML algorithms, their associated benefits, challenges, and outline potential future research directions within the renewable resource domain. Our study centers on conducting an extensive survey of AI and ML techniques as applied to renewable resource management, practical analyses using Linear and Polynomial Regression models are performed on a real-world dataset to showcase the applicability and benefits of AI and ML in renewable resource management. The overarching goal is to unravel how AI and ML methodologies can elevate decision-making processes, finetune resource utilization strategies, and foster sustainable energy practices within the renewable resource sector. This paper offers a detailed examination of the transformative impact of AI and ML techniques on the renewable energy landscape. It delves into the pivotal role played by predictive modeling, optimization algorithms, and data analytics in surmounting the challenges inherent in renewable resource management.

articleTitle: Sea Erosion Prediction and Monitoring Using IOT and ML
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Recent Trends in Microelectronics, Automation, Computing and Communications Systems (ICMACC)
abstract: One of the major environmental issues that the world is currently facing is sea erosion, which requires an innovative solution for early detection and mitigation. Our paper focuses on the integrated system that combines both IoT and Machine Learning. The four main important environmental factors that are responsible for sea erosion are temperature, wave height, wave speed, and soil moisture. IoT sensors deployed along the prototype design are used to monitor these environmental parameters. Another key component is the machine learning algorithm, which is used analyse the interactions, patterns, and relations among the environmental data. By analysing the patterns among the previous data, the model can predict the likelihood of sea erosion events. This allows for the early detection of erosion events and timely interventions that can minimize the damage or loss caused by sea erosion. The main aim of this project is to help the coastal management authority take smart decisions and proactive steps using both real-time and past data analysis.

articleTitle: Trust Based Cooperative Secure Routing Protocols for Internet of Things (IoT)
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Recent Trends in Microelectronics, Automation, Computing and Communications Systems (ICMACC)
abstract: The Internet of Things has rapidly emerged and continues to create services, software, sensors-embedded devices, and protocols. IoT allows physical objects to communicate, exchange information, and make decisions while performing critical jobs. The Internet of Things is enhanced by wireless sensor networks, which serve as a continuous layer. To gain adoption and spread, Internet of things-based sensor networks must overcome serious general and specialized risks and technological hurdles. The main drawbacks of wireless sensor networks are insufficient resources. Internet of Things (IOT)-based Wireless Sensor Networks have issues in energy consumption, longevity, throughput, routing, and security. The goal of this effort was to enhance network longevity, throughput, packet latency/loss, and better encounters with hostile nodes. Consider wireless energy harvesting in the proposed three-layer cluster-based wireless sensor network routing protocol to enhance network lifespan. The proposed approach is a Trust based Cooperative Secure Routing Protocol (TCSRP) technique with security system to obtain malicious activities of objects and to slant them into blacklist. Finally, experiments were done to test the methodology. It outperforms most traditional routing protocols like AODV, DSR, and DSDV.

articleTitle: Classification of Multiple Eye Diseases Using Pretrained Convolution Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Recent Trends in Microelectronics, Automation, Computing and Communications Systems (ICMACC)
abstract: Accurate and timely diagnosis of eye disease is crucial for preventing vision loss. Manual methods for eye disease diagnosis heavily rely on expert ophthalmologists. They make the diagnosis process time-consuming and sometimes even prone to errors due to human limitations. In the literature, several Convolutional Neural Network (CNN)-based classification methods have been proposed for classifying eye diseases from fundus image. However, many methods do not adequately remove the background of the fundus image, which mistakenly leads the model to treat it as a feature. Moreover, the existing methods are limited to classifying a single eye disease, making them less scalable and reducing overall effectiveness. Hence, this paper proposes a novel method using a pre-trained CNN model to classify eye diseases from a fundus image into four classes: Normal, Cataract, Glaucoma, and Diabetic Retinopathy. The proposed method is analyzed using advanced pre-trained models, such as InceptionV3, MobileNetV2, EfficientNetB0, and EfficientNetB1. It classifies multiple eye diseases, which results in better scalability. Additionally, computational efficiency is improved by reducing trainable parameters. The results of the proposed method are measured using metrics, such as accuracy, precision, recall, and F1 score. Among the several pre-trained CNN models tested, MobileNetV2 achieves the highest accuracy of 98.53% outperforming the other pre-trained CNN models.

articleTitle: Spheroid Fractal Patch Antenna for Wireless Applications
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Recent Trends in Microelectronics, Automation, Computing and Communications Systems (ICMACC)
abstract: A novel spheroid fractal microstrip patch aerial with appearance as lollipop contour is proposed and manufactured. The recommended antenna produces frequency band from 2.27-5.83 GHz and 7.00- 10.70 GHz and has been designed with low cost substrate material FR-4. The proposed aerial has been made with two iterations to make the antenna design less complicated. Parametric analysis is been done on parameters feed width, substrate material, substrate thickness, ground defect for proper verification of simulation results. The bandwidth percentage obtained as 90% and 40%. The proposed aerial provides a gain and directivity of 4.3dB and 6dBi respectively. The structure provides applications in WLAN, WiMAX, C band and X band for satellite communication.

articleTitle: Enhancing Safety at Railway Gate Crossings Using Sensors
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Recent Trends in Microelectronics, Automation, Computing and Communications Systems (ICMACC)
abstract: Ensuring safety at railway gate crossings is critical to preventing accidents. This paper presents an innovative system utilizing Infrared (IR) and Passive Infrared (PIR) sensors to enhance safety and automate gate operations at railway crossings. The system monitors trains approaching the crossing from the main station using IR sensors placed every 100 meters along the track. These sensors provide real-time data on the train's location and speed, allowing continuous monitoring and accurate detection of train movements. Additionally, PIR sensors are employed at the crossing gates to detect obstructions or movements, ensuring the gates close only when the tracks are clear. This dual-sensor approach increases the system's reliability, minimizing false positives and ensuring precise gate operation. The integration of IR and PIR sensors creates a comprehensive solution for effective monitoring and management of railway gate crossings. Real-time data from the sensors automates gate operations and provides timely alerts to vehicles and pedestrians, significantly improving safety and preventing accidents. This paper details the design, implementation, and testing of the proposed system, demonstrating its effectiveness in enhancing railway crossing safety. The results show a substantial reduction in accident risk and an overall improvement in the safety and efficiency of railway operations.

articleTitle: Pollutants and Heavy Metal Detection in Water Samples Employing Artificial Intelligence
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Recent Trends in Microelectronics, Automation, Computing and Communications Systems (ICMACC)
abstract: The increasing prevalence of water contamination by heavy metals and other pollutants poses a serious threat to public health. This study presents an innovative approach to detecting pollutants and heavy metals in water samples using Artificial Intelligence (AI). Utilizing a comprehensive dataset containing concentrations of various contaminants such as aluminium, ammonia, arsenic, and lead, we trained and evaluated multiple machine learning models. The models assessed included Decision Trees, Logistic Regression, Support Vector Machines (SVM), Gradient Boosting and Random Forest, with performance metrics such as accuracy, precision, recall, and F1-score used for evaluation. Gradient Boosting achieved the highest performance, demonstrating superior accuracy and reliability in predicting water safety. The methods detects the pollutants with accuracy of 95.6%, 90.93%, 94.15%, 95.75% and 95.8% respectively. The results highlight the potential of AI to significantly enhance the efficiency and accuracy of water quality monitoring systems. By providing real-time assessments of water safety, this AI-enabled approach offers a robust solution for early detection and management of water contamination. This study underscores the critical role of AI in ensuring safe drinking water, thereby contributing to public health protection and environmental sustainability. The integration of AI into water monitoring frameworks can revolutionize the approach to maintaining water quality standards.

articleTitle: Enhancing Predictive Modeling of Diamond Prices using Machine Learning and Meta-Ensemble Techniques
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Recent Trends in Microelectronics, Automation, Computing and Communications Systems (ICMACC)
abstract: Accurate prediction of diamond prices is vital for decision-making in the diamond industry, benefiting all stakeholders. In this study, we employ a comprehensive dataset encompassing various diamond attributes, including cut, color, clarity, carat weight, and engineered features. We explore the predictive capabilities of traditional machine learning (ML) algorithms such as Linear Regression, Ridge Regression, Lasso Regression, Decision Tree Regression, Gradient Boosting Regression, Random Forest Regression, and AdaBoost Regression. Subsequently, we investigate the efficacy of ensemble techniques, including Bagging, Voting, and Stacking, aiming to enhance predictive accuracy and robustness. This research rigorously evaluates and compares these models' performance using established metrics, including Root Mean Squared Error(RMSE), R-squared, and Mean Absolute Error(MAE). Additionally, we suggest a novel strategy that uses ensemble model predictions as features to train a Meta-Model, increasing prediction accuracy even further. This study's results highlight how well machine learning and ensemble methods can predict diamond prices. We clarify the benefits and drawbacks of different modeling techniques through comparison analysis, offering insights into the best techniques for estimating diamond prices. This study gives stakeholders in the diamond business useful information and a data-driven method for predicting prices and making decisions.

Index Terms: Least Absolute Shrinkage And Selection Operator

articleTitle: Analysis of Grid Integrated PV System for Different Load Power Factors
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Recent Trends in Microelectronics, Automation, Computing and Communications Systems (ICMACC)
abstract: The growing apprehension over global warming, along with rising energy needs, has propelled the traditional power infrastructure towards greater reliability through integration of renewable energies into grid. Incorporating renewable energies into grid presents numerous challenges. Throughout the day, the output power of the photovoltaic systems fluctuates. This paper elucidates how various power factors on the load side affect the entire system. Several simulation cases are conducted using different power factors to analyze the impact on the entire grid-integrated PV system. Furthermore, it is observed that the converter and filter design play major role in synchronization of PV with grid. Developing sufficient control techniques for grid-connected inverter equipped with LCL filter is a complex task. The grid integrated PV system is explored through simulations conducted in MATLAB/Simulink, where an initial network model is developed for the PV power system. This paper suggests that the low value of the power factor may lead to heavy damage due to the high current flow in loads and these simulation results are presented as per power factors extemporizations.

articleTitle: An IoT based solution for Energy Conservation in Educational Institutions- a case study
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Recent Trends in Microelectronics, Automation, Computing and Communications Systems (ICMACC)
abstract: In today's world, effective energy management is important, given its significant role in human development and its direct correlation with population growth. Educational institutions, as significant consumers of energy, employ it across various activities like lighting, heating, cooling, laboratory work, and computing. However, inefficient management and equipment can result in considerable energy wastage. Minimizing energy waste in educational settings is crucial for both financial savings and fostering a culture of sustainability among student communities. By identifying areas of inefficiency, energy audits aim to provide actionable insights to reduce energy consumption, lower expenses, improve operational efficiency, and reduce environmental impact. Motivated by these principles, the authors conducted a preliminary energy audit to pinpoint sources of waste within their institution. Subsequently, proposed, designed, and implemented an IoT-based solution to manage energy consumption intelligently that results in 42.85% of energy saving. The proposed system aims to promote energy conservation by identifying and eliminating inefficient practices, optimizing energy utilization, and ultimately reducing organizational expenses. By adopting energy-saving strategies, institutions can enhance productivity and demonstrate social responsibility in striving for a sustainable future.

articleTitle: Key Management in Space Integrated Terrestrial Network: A Cybersecurity Perspective
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Recent Trends in Microelectronics, Automation, Computing and Communications Systems (ICMACC)
abstract: Satellite networks comprise of large number of satellite constellations. It makes the management of keys used for different security mechanism a very important issue to be studied. Key management is set of procedure that creates, exchange, store, delete and refresh the keys. Ensuring secure key management across satellite-terrestrial integrated networks (STIN) is very challenging. It is one of the challenging area due to large number of keys and their frequent updating by satellite nodes. How often the key is to be updated also need to considered. It may depend on services of type of data communication. If keys are updated very frequently, it induces a large overhead on the system. This paper aims to focus on the role of key management in providing security in STIN. Different key management schemes are analyzed and various research gaps along with future research directions are given. It will serve as a foundation for future research in STIN security.

articleTitle: Unveiling Crime Patterns and Empowering Investigative Insights Through Machine Learning and NLP
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Recent Trends in Microelectronics, Automation, Computing and Communications Systems (ICMACC)
abstract: The well-being of society and public safety are severely threatened by crime. Policymakers, law enforcement agencies, and community stakeholders must comprehend the distribution of crimes, their patterns, and the variables that drive criminal activity. Stakeholders may identify regional patterns in crime by visualising state-level crime data, which facilitates the allocation of resources to high-risk locations and supports targeted actions. Furthermore, content recommendation systems provide relevant information about crimes, enabling stakeholders to design successful crime prevention plans and back community engagement programmes with the knowledge and tools they need. These actual criminal scenarios may be effectively addressed with the help of the models used in this study. With the use of regression models, law enforcement organisations and legislators may forecast future trends and effectively deploy resources by doing predictive analysis of crime rates based on previous data. Additionally, the powerful natural language processing techniques used by the content recommendation system make it easier for stakeholders to receive pertinent information about crimes. The technology improves accessibility to actionable ideas and best practices in crime prevention and intervention by using machine learning algorithms to evaluate user searches and article content. In general, the incorporation of these models provides stakeholders with data-driven decision-making abilities, enabling them to successfully tackle criminal activity and protect communities.

articleTitle: Advanced Deep Learning for Emotion Recognition: A Hybrid Model Combining Spatial and Temporal Analysis
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Recent Trends in Microelectronics, Automation, Computing and Communications Systems (ICMACC)
abstract: It is necessary to distinguish that emotion recognition is among the significant tasks in various fields, including human-computer interaction, affective computing, and psychological research. This research presents a new deep learning model that incorporates two types of deep learning: CNNs to address the spatial aspect of face emotion detection and RNNs for the temporal aspect of face emotion detection. We have employed two widely used datasets, FER-2013 and AffectNet, to evaluate the proposed model. On FER-2013, the hybrid model achieved a classification score of 79.8 percent, while AffectNet achieved 85.3 percent, combining higher levels than traditional CNN-based models. As for the F1 scores reached 79.5% and 85.5%, showing an improved ability to categorize subtle differences in emotions. The confusion matrix analysis showed enhancement of the separation between similar feelings, for instance, fear and surprise, compared to the baseline CNN models. The model's generalizability was done with other datasets, with FER-2013 yielding an AUC of 0.88 and AffectNet giving an AUC of 90. This strong generalization makes the hybrid model suitable for applied applications where the facial expression data might have frequent significant changes. CNN and RNN integration helped the model to understand both static and temporal features of the emotion and made the model catch the complex changes of the emotions accurately. These results support this blended approach for advancing emotion recognition technology and providing reliable solutions for emotion-aware systems.

articleTitle: Enhanced Cross-Coupled Voltage Controlled Oscillator Design Through Tuned Amplifier Integration
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Recent Trends in Microelectronics, Automation, Computing and Communications Systems (ICMACC)
abstract: This paper presents a comparative analysis of various Voltage-Controlled Oscillator (VCO) designs, focusing on key performance parameters such as tuning control voltage range, phase noise, delay, power consumption, and frequency range. The Proposed Tunable Amplifier VCO (TA-VCO) exhibits a wide tuning control voltage range of 0.6 – 7.5 V, enabling greater flexibility in frequency adjustment. While the Proposed TA-VCO operates within a higher frequency range of 0.9 – 1.31 GHz, suitable for high-speed applications, it does so at the cost of increased power consumption at 171.043 µW. The findings suggest that the TA-VCO provides a balanced performance in high-frequency applications, though the choice of VCO design should be guided by specific application requirements, whether prioritizing phase noise, power efficiency, or operating frequency.

articleTitle: CNN Based Restoration of Remote Sensing Imagery through Denoising Schemes
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Recent Trends in Microelectronics, Automation, Computing and Communications Systems (ICMACC)
abstract: Image restoration through denoising is a technique used to remove noise from noisy images generated by sensor malfunctions, environmental factors, lossy compression algorithms, electrical interference, and so on. To improve the image quality, we present a novel approach using a deep convolutional neural network, which involves of two convolution layers with a ReLU activation function, one convolution layer with no activation function, and a convolution layer with a sigmoid function to limit the mapping value to a range between 0 and 1. To evaluate the customized model architecture, we generated some noisy images using salt and pepper noise and fed them into the neural network as noisy input, with the final output generated after the fourth convolution layer with the sigmoid function. The experimental results are astonishing and outperform most of the deep CNN models over the past decade.

articleTitle: Single Channel EEG Based Sleep Stage Prediction Using CNN-CNN and CNN-LSTM
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Recent Trends in Microelectronics, Automation, Computing and Communications Systems (ICMACC)
abstract: Sleep is one of the important things in human health and a critical aspect of physical and mental well-being. Adequate sleep is necessary for humans. The assessment of sleep stages through Polysomnography (PSG) is a widely used method to evaluate sleep quality. Sleep stage sequencing is critical for identifying sleep disorders, which is usually done by trained professionals by observing Electroencephalogram (EEG), Electrocardiogram (ECG), and Electromyogram (EMG) belonging to PSG data. This data is obtained by recording the brain waves from the scalp of the object. In this work, single-channel EEG data is analyzed to identify the sleep stages in 5 categories using supervised learning. With the fast growth in Artificial Intelligence (AI), it is now easy to design and develop Deep Learning (DL) techniques to automatically classify sleep stages. DL models offer high computational efficiency and have shown promising results in the field of bio-medical signal processing. In this work, considered well-known architectures CNN and LSTM and cascaded them as CNN-CNN & CNN-LSTM. The proposed cascading models exhibited good performance on PSG data taken from physiobank (Sleep EDFX) for sleep stage classification. The proposed model yields with accuracy of 89 % for CNN-CNN and 84 % for CNN-LSTM.

articleTitle: Performance Analysis of BLDC Motor in PV-Battery Integrated System with ANN MPPT
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Recent Trends in Microelectronics, Automation, Computing and Communications Systems (ICMACC)
abstract: This research discusses the use of artificial neural networks (ANN) to monitor peak power. Neural networks are trained via the error back propagation approach. One benefit of neural networks is their ability to track maximum power points accurately and quickly. Here, the maximum power point's reference voltage is set using a neural network training process in different atmospheric circumstances through appropriate DC-DC boost converter management. The ANN-MPPT approach makes it feasible to soft start a BLDC motor. The BLDC motor's speed is managed via pulse width modulated control of the voltage source inverter via a DC-link voltage controller. The built-in encoder generates a PWM signal, which is then used to carry out electrical commutation through hall signal detection. The performance of the BLDC motor load is evaluated using the MATLAB/Simulink environment. The addition of a battery via a bidirectional DC-DC converter allows for the maintenance of a steady power supply in the context of fluctuating loads and irradiance levels. This paper also covers the battery's charging and discharging modes.

articleTitle: Clusterboost: An Airbnb Recommendation Engine Using Metaclustering
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Recent Trends in Microelectronics, Automation, Computing and Communications Systems (ICMACC)
abstract: In a bustling city like New York, selecting an ideal accommodation can be overwhelming due to the multitude of available options on platforms like Airbnb. This paper introduces ClusterBoost, a recommendation engine designed to offer personalized accommodations by leveraging meta-clustering techniques. Using a comprehensive Airbnb dataset, multiple clustering algorithms, including K-Means, DBSCAN, and Agglomerative Clustering, are employed to group similar listings based on features such as location, amenities, and pricing. The system then applies an ensemble model to combine the strengths of these algorithms, ensuring a more accurate and refined recommendation process. The final step of Spectral Clustering further optimizes the recommendations by aggregating results from the individual clusters. Cosine similarity is used to match user preferences with available listings, providing tailored suggestions. By combining these clustering techniques, ClusterBoost enhances the recommendation process, offering personalized, user-centric accommodation suggestions that improve user satisfaction and streamline decision-making.

articleTitle: Integrated Door Opening and Lane Change Warning System (IDOLCWS)
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Recent Trends in Microelectronics, Automation, Computing and Communications Systems (ICMACC)
abstract: The human race has developed various automobiles for faster transportation from one place to another place. But these automobiles are the main cause of human loss in the current trend. Various reasons cause these accidents, out of which three main reasons are accidental door openings, unforeseen lane shifts, and blind spot misses during parking. These accidents are persistent and happen very often, posing a severe threat to drivers, pedestrians, other drivers, and pavilion passengers, if luck is on our side, it would just pause at the cost of vehicle damage. To prevent all these occurrences, the “Integrated Door Opening And Lane Change Warning System” was introduced. This Integrated Door Opening And Lane Change Warning System is an apparatus that keeps a constant eye on the surroundings at all times. It is an integration of sensors that is installed into the vehicle which checks for any approaching vehicles, pedestrians, or bikers that are in the circumference of it. If the apparatus notes the presence, it takes action accordingly. Rather than acting upon the incident after its occurrence, this system tries to prevent it, upon detecting the contingency of an accident. Even if the passenger catches a blind spot, the Integrated Door Opening And Lane Change Warning System has your back, keeping track of all the surroundings and letting everyone in the vehicle at ease.

articleTitle: Portable Multiparameter Biomedical Sensor Fusion for Home Healthcare
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Recent Trends in Microelectronics, Automation, Computing and Communications Systems (ICMACC)
abstract: The ever-increasing focus on preventative healthcare and remote patient monitoring has driven the need for innovative solutions. Traditionally, measuring vital signs in both clinical and home settings has relied on a collection of individual devices, often leading to cluttered setups, patient discomfort, and potential inaccuracies due to user error. This paper proposes a multi-parameter acquisition system designed to address these limitations. The system integrates the measurement of essential parameters into a single, user-friendly device. This streamlined approach not only reduces measurement complexity but also improves patient comfort by eliminating the need for multiple devices and cumbersome wires. The design of the system, including its sensors, hardware components, and data processing unit is presented in detail. The device serves a dual purpose. Firstly, it empowers individuals at home by providing them with a single device to monitor their vital signs. Secondly, for hospitals, the device offers a streamlined and less cumbersome way to visualize essential patient parameters, allowing for improved monitoring efficiency.

articleTitle: Fault Analysis of Ship DC Power System
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Recent Trends in Microelectronics, Automation, Computing and Communications Systems (ICMACC)
abstract: In the recent past, the marine industry has slowly but steadily moved towards the DC hybrid shipboard systems. The operational flexibility of DC hybrid ship systems with improved efficiency and reliability has attracted marine engineers. In the traditional AC ship systems, the dependence on modern power electronic equipment in propulsion, lighting and communication systems has increased the system's complexity. This is primarily due to the onboard AC-DC conversion systems and associated power losses. However, in a DC ship system, the issue of conversion systems is resolved, and the overall system efficiency is improved. The introduction of energy storage into DC systems can be referred to as Hybrid DC Ship power systems. This further reduces the dependence on fossil fuels and improves operational flexibility. Despite the merits, DC shipboard power systems pose particular challenges. One of them, and this paper's focus, is fault detection and isolation. Unlike AC systems, DC systems do not show much variation in the voltage and current waveforms during fault conditions. If a fault is occurred in any one of the location, the impact is experienced at other locations also. This paper details a Hybrid DC shipboard power system to understand the challenge of localizing a fault. The performance of the system at the different locations of the system are analyzed. The voltage and current waveforms at the generator, DC bus and loads connected to external DC bus are analyzed when a fault is created on the thruster load.

articleTitle: ML Based Multi-Faceted Health Monitoring Devices: Enhancing Elderly Well-Being
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Recent Trends in Microelectronics, Automation, Computing and Communications Systems (ICMACC)
abstract: This research paper explores the application, implementation, and assessment of health parameters in the elderly healthcare sector using Random Forest and Support Vector Machine algorithms in Machine Learning. These algorithms increase the accuracy and predictive capabilities of health monitoring devices that analyze heart rate, fall risks, stress levels, and hypertension in the elderly in real time. The integration of IoT technology into the system ensures continuous and efficient monitoring with reliable communication and connectivity. The sensors are located to pick up essential health data, which provides the baseline for a deep analysis of health trends. This paper elaborates on how machine learning predicts and monitors health parameters in the elderly population.

articleTitle: Economic Load Dispatch Using Quantum Particle Swarm Optimization Technique
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Recent Trends in Microelectronics, Automation, Computing and Communications Systems (ICMACC)
abstract: Economic Load Dispatch (ELD) is a key aspect of any practical power system network. ELD is an optimization technique aimed at allocating power generation among the various available power creating units to limit the overall generation cost while satisfying operational constraints. The conventional methods for solving ELD include the Lagrangian Multiplier Technique (LMT), Gradient method etc. These conventional methods become complex if the number of buses is increased and take a greater amount of computational time to solve. By using Heuristic methods like Genetic Algorithm (GA), Particle Swarm Optimization (PSO), etc., the complexity of problem solving can be reduced to a greater extent. In this paper, an enhanced method of PSO known as Quantum Particle Swarm Optimization (QPSO) is used to solve the ELD problem to achieve more benefits of heuristic methods. ELD considering line losses is solved using LMT, GA, PSO and QPSO and the comparative analysis is done by applying these methods to 3-bus and 6-bus test systems. The simulation code is executed in MATLAB.

articleTitle: Multi-Modal Framework for Skin Lesion Classification Using Deep Learning and Machine Learning Techniques
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Recent Trends in Microelectronics, Automation, Computing and Communications Systems (ICMACC)
abstract: Skin cancer, especially melanoma, is one of the most threatening diseases of the modern world. Therefore, accurate and timely diagnosis is critical. This work proposes a methodology based on CNNs and SVM for the dermoscopic and clinical picture classification of skin cancer. The foundation aims to enhance diagnostic consistency using the complementary properties of various imaging techniques. Continuing the tradition of the previous years, HAM10000 and the ISIC 2020 datasets became available to the public. The outcome suggests that the proposed multimodal method CNN-SVM is far better than simple CNN models. The recommended technique achieved a measure of accuracy of 92.5%, precision of91.8%, recall of 92.0%, F1 score of91.9%, and ROC-AUC of 0.95. The CNN model trained on dermoscopic pictures achieved an accuracy of 89.3% and ROC-AUC of 0.92, while the CNN model with clinical images numbered 84.7% and ROC AUC of 0.88%. The improvement of the multimodal method is attributed to the incorporation of complex lesion-specific features from dermoscopic photos and contextual information from clinical images. Thus, the current study focuses on the ability of the SVM to comprehend the features of high-dimensional data and the classification of instances that are often near the decision boundary and closely or equally related to any class. The offered methodology has potential, though small participant numbers and high photo quality limit its applicability. Future work should focus on data extension and management of real-world uncertainty. As such, this study shows that the proposed CNN-SVM multimodal model is a reliable and accurate tool for skin cancer diagnosis in clinical settings.

articleTitle: A Novel Method for Power Theft Detection Using PLC and GOT and Cyber Physical Attack Protection System
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Recent Trends in Microelectronics, Automation, Computing and Communications Systems (ICMACC)
abstract: Programmable Logic Controllers (PLCs) have significantly advanced industrial automation by replacing traditional computing systems. A comprehensive approach is proposed for securing critical power systems through a Power Theft Detection and Cyber-Physical Attack Protection System that employs PLCs and Graphical Operator Terminals (GOTs). As power grids increasingly integrate with SCADA systems, the vulnerabilities of unauthorized access, power theft, and cyber-physical attacks become more pronounced. Our system addresses these challenges by continuously monitoring power grid data in real-time using PLCs, incorporating robust encryption, and promptly responding to potential threats. The integration of PLCs and GOTs provides operators with a user-friendly interface, thereby enhancing the protection of modern power distribution networks against cyber threats and power theft. Traditional methods of power theft detection, such as manual inspections orbasic metering techniques, are vulnerable to manipulation and evasion. In contrast, our solution leverages PLCs for real-time monitoring of power consumption patterns and deviations, enabling early detection of suspicious activities indicative of power theft. The inclusion of a Graphical Operator Terminal facilitates intuitive visualization and control of the detection system, while the integration of cyber-physical attack protection mechanisms ensures the system's resilience against malicious intrusions and manipulations.

articleTitle: Automatic License Plate Detection Using Information Processing System Vision and Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Recent Trends in Microelectronics, Automation, Computing and Communications Systems (ICMACC)
abstract: The content of this probe is to overcome the current cognitive content with ALPR playacting, with a special accent on developing a dead and impelling playacting for distinguishing License plates from video film. The study attempts to ameliorate the presentation norms of ALPR technology by utilizing the powerful accumulation of optical character identification (OCR)[20] and deep learning based object detection algorithmic program. The core of this occupation is the use of the cutting-edge YOLOv8. object distinguishing hypothesis, which has been pains taking and disciplined on an unequaled dataset premeditated with License plate detection in mind. Focusing on quality and efficiency, the YOLOv8 model accomplish an amazing 99.8 quality rate when it comes to accurately localization and categorization License plates[18] inside video frames. This occupation aims to formalize the willingness and dependability of the advisable ALPR playacting through extensive scientific research. The project aims to intensify ALPR technology and determinant the forthcoming of transport and police investigation playactings[18] by breaking through current obstruction and establishing new presentation norms.

articleTitle: Comprehensive Analysis and Validation of an All Terrain Electric Bike Chassis- the GAVISTI
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Recent Trends in Microelectronics, Automation, Computing and Communications Systems (ICMACC)
abstract: This paper describes in full-length design and development of a custom-made electric bicycle (e-bike) The Gavisti, with a focus on rider comfort and excellent performance. To do this, several thorough examinations of the e-bike's essential parts were carried out. First, a comprehensive structural examination of the e-bike's frame was carried out. The strength, stiffness, weight efficiency, and safety factor of the chassis-all essential components for a high-performance e-bike-were confirmed by this examination. Secondly, a dynamic study was conducted to assess the general performance of the e-bike in different riding scenarios. Throughout the whole development process, the choices made regarding the design and component selection were informed by the insightful information obtained from this thorough research. Ultimately, a thorough investigation of the selected suspension system was conducted to guarantee the best possible shock absorption and handling qualities that were specially designed for the e-bike's intended use. This led to the creation of a unique e-bike with outstanding handling qualities, efficiency, and rider comfort all balanced for understanding purposes added photos and tabular forms.

articleTitle: Exploring Jammer Techniques for Improving Secrecy in SWIPT Aided NOMA Networks
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Recent Trends in Microelectronics, Automation, Computing and Communications Systems (ICMACC)
abstract: In this paper, a Simultaneous Wireless Information and Power Transmission (SWIPT) enabled Non-Orthogonal Multiple Access (NOMA) network is explored, and the variation of secrecy rate is investigated. Analysis is conducted on how the secrecy rate can be enhanced through the implementation of jammers. The setup comprises a base station and two users (a near user and a far user). Utilizing the SWIPT protocol, power and information are transmitted together from the base station, with Energy Harvesting (EH) carried out at the near user. Further, Successive Interference Cancellation (SIC) is employed at the near user to mitigate noise. Jammers are deployed to produce interference noise, and the Signal-to-Noise Ratio (SNR) is measured for both legitimate users and eavesdroppers to assess the level of secrecy. Finally, the CJ approach yields a marked increase of approximately 64% for near user in secrecy rate compared to alternative jamming methods, as evidenced by Monte Carlo simulations.

IEEE Keywords: Simultaneous wireless information and power transfer

articleTitle: A Remarkable Innovation Empowering the Visually Impaired: The Smart Blind Stick for Independent Navigation
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Recent Trends in Microelectronics, Automation, Computing and Communications Systems (ICMACC)
abstract: The Smart Blind Stick represents a groundbreaking innovation aimed at enhancing independent navigation for individuals with visual impairments. Unlike conventional white canes, this advanced device integrates modern technologies such as GPS, GSM, and ultrasonic sensors to detect obstacles and provide real-time location tracking. Additionally, a remote-control feature for auditory localization allows users to locate the stick easily, ensuring higher levels of independence and safety. This paper delves into the Smart Blind Stick's hardware implementation, algorithmic functionality, real-time operation scenarios, and performance evaluation. Through extensive experimentation and validation, the Smart Blind Stick proves to be a promising solution, significantly improving the mobility and autonomy of visually impaired individuals and transforming their navigation experience.

articleTitle: Text Filtering Insignificant Word (TFIW) Readability Framework Model to Explain NLP in Sentiment Analysis Using Reinforcement Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Recent Trends in Microelectronics, Automation, Computing and Communications Systems (ICMACC)
abstract: Reading of a text in a given sentence have lot of parameters to consider for expressing an opinion on a given text to conclude nature of the text. The data which need to be formed in the form of data sets based on specific constrains. The Natural Language Processing (NLP) will always presume that Text readability made as the considerable measure for better round spread of any newspaper. The data related to these documents must be collected and store them in data sets. During this process of measuring text readability at the granular level of the text reading is a cumbersome task. This will always implicate a problem of machine readability of the text and explainability of the text taken from the documents mentioned above. In this context human readability will act an important role in predicting the text reading at granular level where the text-based sentiment analysis have been predicted through a machine learning model. The text reading has been evaluated in order to improve the readability through explainable system. The explainable systems will capture and explain the predictions of text reading. In this technical work an explainable system Text Filtering Insignificant Word (TFIW) is introduced where it improves the textual reading at the granule level based on sentiments by prediction the words which need to be filtered. This will improve the explainability of text and text reading and improve the fast text and explainability of the document.

articleTitle: Time Switching Based Uplink Transmission in User Cooperative NOMA Networks
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Recent Trends in Microelectronics, Automation, Computing and Communications Systems (ICMACC)
abstract: In this paper, we investigated the performance analysis of uplink cooperative non-orthogonal multiple access (NOMA), where the devices use harvested energy for transferring their messages to the access point (AP). To improve the Far User (FU) performance we considered direct and cooperation links to the far user transmission. In the first phase, FU transmits its message to the AP and Near User (NU), in the second phase NU adopts NOMA transmission to transfer its message and far user message to the Access point. We have derived the outage probability and throughput and analyzed them with different parameters. We performed Monte Carlo simulations to verify the theoretical analysis.

articleTitle: FG-PIH: A Fusion of Fresnelet Transform and Gradient Directional Pattern for Perceptual Image Hashing
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Recent Trends in Microelectronics, Automation, Computing and Communications Systems (ICMACC)
abstract: Perceptual image hashing is pivotal in various image processing applications, including image authentication, content-based image retrieval, tampered image detection, and copyright protection. This paper proposes a novel approach for perceptual image hashing by combining the Fresnelet Transform with Gradient Directional Patterns. Using the FG-PIH technique, the proposed method achieves superior robustness against common image processing attacks while maintaining perceptual similarity for near-duplicate images. Experimental results on standard benchmark datasets demonstrate the effectiveness and efficiency of the proposed Fresnelet Transform-based perceptual image hashing scheme. Furthermore, comparative analysis against state-of-the-art methods underscores the competitiveness of our approach in terms of hash quality and computational complexity.

articleTitle: A Deep Learning Approach for YouTube Music Recommendation Based on Facial Emotion
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Recent Trends in Microelectronics, Automation, Computing and Communications Systems (ICMACC)
abstract: In the contemporary digital era, the intersection of emotion recognition technology and music recommendation systems has paved the way for a transformative user experience. This research introduces an innovative “Emotion-Based Music Recommendation System,” designed to enhance the personalization of music consumption. Leveraging real-time facial expression analysis and a curated music dataset, the system dynamically adapts to users' emotional states, providing a sealess and engaging music discovery process. The integration of Facial Recognition (FR) technology enables the system to capture and interpret users' moods instantaneously, eliminating the need for manual classification of songs. This novel approach not only streaDlines the user experience but also holds significant potential for mitigating revenue loss associated with prolonged music search times. The research utilizes Python and PyCharm, employing Haar cascades for face detection and collaborative filtering and content-based filtering methods for music recommendation. The datasets utilized include FER, containing grayscale images of faces classified into seven emotions, and YouTube Music data, incorporating diverse attributes for mood-based classification. Through this synthesis of facial recognition and music datasets, the proposed system stands poised to redefine the landscape of music recommendation, emphasizing real-time adaptability and user-centricity.

articleTitle: A Method for Predicting Coronary Heart Disease Using Machine Learning Approaches
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Recent Trends in Microelectronics, Automation, Computing and Communications Systems (ICMACC)
abstract: Predicting a patient's heart disease risk is a major difficulty in medical data analysis for preventative measures and mortality reduction. Early diagnosis is essential for timely treatment and continuing monitoring by healthcare professionals, however medical staff's limitations in patient surveillance frequently prevent it. Early cardiac problem detection and medical monitoring reduce fatality rates. The accuracy of heart disease detection is uncertain, and clinicians cannot regularly communicate with patients. Machine learning (ML) may help clinicians identify and forecast heart diseases using global healthcare data. This project will employ many feature selection methods to create a viable ML system for early heart disease prediction. It is possible to correctly forecast cardiac illness using a variety of machine learning methods, including Logistic Regression, Random Forest, Naïve Bayes classifier, Decision Tree, and LRND classifier. With the help of nearby technology, these algorithms may detect heart problems and provide treatment.

articleTitle: Smart Monitoring of Leg Exercises in Fitness Centers: A CNN-LSTM Model for Enhanced Gym Safety and Efficiency
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Recent Trends in Microelectronics, Automation, Computing and Communications Systems (ICMACC)
abstract: Preventing injuries and achieving the exercise's desired effect must be imperative; it applies to exercising in the gym, especially when it comes to the lower body, including squats, lunges, and leg presses with problematic form. This work proposes a CNN-LSTM model used for the appropriate identification of leg-building activities to make real-time exercise tracking and evaluation improved. The model also uses CNN layers to acquire spatial information from frames which are limb locations, and other angles while the LSTM layers study temporal patterns to determine movement pattern over time. Training and assessment yielded reliable performance with cross validation resulted in an accuracy of 94% and precise values of squats 0.94, lunges 0.91 and leg press 0.92. High recall scores of 0.96 for squats, 0.93 for lunges, and, 0.94 for leg press also imply that the application provides extensive coverage of leg workouts that is sensitive to variation. An ablation research carried out on a combination of CNN-only, LSTM-only, and the CNN-LSTM model supported the hybrid architecture with an accuracy rate of 94 percent opposed to CNN-only 88 percent and LSTM-only 85 percent. In addition, ROC analysis provided evidence that the method had a strong discriminative capacity with the three AUC values: 0.97 for squats; 0.95 for lunges; 0.96 for leg presses. Two particular achievements are obvious from the statistical outcomes:. This CNN-LSTM system can be considered as an objective tool for automatic and immediate exercise tracking within the fitness contexts.

articleTitle: Mobile Health Solutions for Effective Symptom Detection and Disease Management Using Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Recent Trends in Microelectronics, Automation, Computing and Communications Systems (ICMACC)
abstract: People in today's world are so busy with work and other commitments that they rarely have time to see doctors for illnesses that initially seem minor but eventually become life-threatening. In the above situations, where patients do not have easy access to healthcare or face difficulties in utilizing it, this can be very useful in helping them understand the urgency of their health condition. The suggested algorithm makes use of machine learning to forecast diseases based on user-provided symptoms. The flow of the disease diagnosis support system using symptoms is as follows: First, data pre-processing is performed, and several machine learning classification models, including K Nearest Neighbor, are then applied to the data, Random Forest, and Support Vector Machine (SVM). The accuracy of each model is calculated to aid in predicting the disease based on the mentioned symptoms. The predicted disease is then sent back to the application, where it is displayed to the user. Our model primarily focuses on seasonal infections and diseases.

articleTitle: ResQ2way – SOS Alerting and Two Way Tracking Device Using A9G Board
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Recent Trends in Microelectronics, Automation, Computing and Communications Systems (ICMACC)
abstract: The “ResQ2way - SOS Alerting and Two-Way Tracking Device using A9G Board” is an innovative solution for emergency response and vehicle tracking. This compact, budget-friendly device integrates an A9G Board and Xiao ESP32-C3 MCU with built-in GSM and GPS modules, offering dual functionality as an SOS alert system and a vehicle tracker. In accidents, it automatically alerts pre-configured contacts with real-time GPS location data, allowing for prompt action. The device's impact sensor detects collisions, enhancing safety for vehicle users and families. It also enables live vehicle tracking by transmitting GPS coordinates, providing security and peace of mind. This device can make emergency calls for precise location verification, ensuring reliable information. Designed for user-friendliness, it is ideal for schoolchildren and women. By integrating Arduino, GSM, and GPS modules into a single unit, the ResQ2way simplifies tracking and alerting. Its compact, cost-effective design makes it accessible to a wider audience, addressing critical tracking and emergency alert needs effectively.

articleTitle: Hybrid Deep Learning for Multi-Modal Image Fusion: Elevating Brain Tumor Detection
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Recent Trends in Microelectronics, Automation, Computing and Communications Systems (ICMACC)
abstract: This work presents a new dual deep learning framework that incorporates CNNs and ViTs into the multi-modal medical picture fusion to enhance the diagnostic accuracy of the diagnosed brain tumour. This integration concerns MRI and PET information, applying the ability of CNNs to handle local spatial information and ViTs in collecting long-range relationships. Here, to test the efficacy of the proposed model, a publicly available multi-modal brain tumour database was used, where significant performance improvements were achieved over the conventional techniques. The developed model achieved a sensitivity of 96.8%, while the traditional CNN-based methods attained a sensitivity of only 91.2%. In addition, the research used it to achieve a high accuracy rate of 95.7 percent, a recall rate of 95.1 percent, and an F1 score of 95.4 percent for infallibility in locating tumors with minimal false positives and negatives. It was realized that the model in this study provided improved picture quality, with an SSIM of 0.89 compared to the 0.82 of earlier fusion techniques. The pilot qualitative study confirmed that the work of the fused pictures showed a better combination of PET and MRI information by merging spatial features with metabolic data to help distinguish the tumour's boundaries more clearly and identify small or irregular form tumours. The proposed CNN-ViT model outperforms other methods for detecting tumors with high levels of accuracy and high-quality images that give medicine a vital tool. The methodology has high potential to be applied to other medical imaging jobs as well.

articleTitle: Design of a Low Noise Figure LNA Using Multilayered Inductor for RF Applications
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Recent Trends in Microelectronics, Automation, Computing and Communications Systems (ICMACC)
abstract: The structure of a Multilayer inductor with the application of a Low Noise Amplifier (LNA) is presented in this paper. The proposed inductor was realized in a 60μm x 60μm area and compared with conventional planar inductors. High-Q inductors are critical for the design and development of MMICs and radio-frequency integrated circuits (RFICs). To enhance the quality factor, a multilayer inductor is designed innovatively by dividing each metal section into two specific layers to reduce the current crowding effect and effective parasitic capacitance. The proposed inductor was simulated using SONNET (EM) simulation software and the results confirmed a 17% improvement in the quality factor. To verify the overall performance of the inductor, a low-noise amplifier was designed, resulting in a simulated noise coefficient of 1.

articleTitle: An Efficient Selection Gate Logic Based Ripple Carry Adder for Deep Learning Networks
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Recent Trends in Microelectronics, Automation, Computing and Communications Systems (ICMACC)
abstract: Full adders are fundamental components in digital circuit design, responsible for binary addition. Of late in Deep learning network architectures. Conventional full adder implementations often they are limited in terms of their speed, area, and power consumption. This study proposes a novel full adder architecture using multiplexers to overcome these challenges. This paper presents an enhanced VLSI (Very-Large-Scale Integration). A Ripple Carry Adder based multiplexer specially optimized for deep learning applications compared to traditional full Adder designs. Deep learning is a subset of artificial intelligence (AI) that teaches computers to mimic the human brain and process data. The introduction of this optimized RCA is expected to not only speed up the computation process but contributes to the overall efficiency of the deep learning network, making it more efficient in the design of the next Generation AI Processor. The proposed design utilizes a structured approach leveraging multiplexers to minimize delay and improve overall performance. The design is implemented as a ripple carry adder and extended to 64 bits to demonstrate scalability. The static analysis and simulation results up to 64-bit implementation reveal substantial reductions in delay, area, and power, making this design a highly efficient solution for modern high-speed digital systems

articleTitle: Detection and Analysis of Autism Spectrum Disorder Using Random Forest Classifier
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Recent Trends in Microelectronics, Automation, Computing and Communications Systems (ICMACC)
abstract: Autism Spectrum Disorder (ASD) diagnosis is difficult due to its complex and diverse symptomatology. This study focuses on using machine learning, specifically the Random Forest algorithm, to identify ASD. We use a large dataset including behavioural and demographic characteristics to pre-process, select features, and assess the model's performance in differentiating ASD cases. Our findings emphasize the Random Forest classifier's predictive powers and its potential to aid in early ASD diagnosis in clinical settings, potentially improving intervention outcomes.

articleTitle: Modeling, Analysis and 3D Printing of a Slalom Water Ski
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Recent Trends in Microelectronics, Automation, Computing and Communications Systems (ICMACC)
abstract: Ski is one of the essential components in water skiing sport. Water skiing involves pulling of a skier by a boat or a cable ski installation such that two skis or one ski skims the surface of the water. Conventionally, a ski is made of carbon fiber material using compression molding process. Increased cost of water skis due to the use of expensive material and high skilled labor has led researchers to take it as research. In this work, a feasibility study for manufacturing water skis using additive manufacturing process has been carried out. The water ski is modelled in CREO Parametric software and static structural, modal and fluid flow analyses are performed on CFRP, ABS and PLA materials in ANSYS software for determining co-efficient of lift and drag. Scaled models of water ski have been 3D printed with ABS and PLA materials. It has been realized that if CFRP can be used to 3D print the skis, then there would be significant reduction o f 5 0 % in the manufacturing costs of the water skis.

articleTitle: Proximal Femur Segmentation from the Fluoroscopy Image Using DeeplabV3+ Model
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Recent Trends in Microelectronics, Automation, Computing and Communications Systems (ICMACC)
abstract: Segmenting the proximal femur from a fluoroscopy image is crucial for precise surgical treatment of proximal femur fracture. Accurate segmentation of the proximal femur helps the surgeon to insert screws and metal pins correctly during the treatment of the proximal femur fracture. Traditional machine learning-based segmentation methods have limitations in precisely capturing the complex and variable anatomy of the proximal femur. Deep learning-based segmentation methods offer promising solutions to overcome the limitations of machine learning-based methods. However, they struggle with problems like hyperparameter tuning and spatial context handling. Hence, this paper proposes a novel proximal femur segmentation approach utilizing encoder-decoder-based architecture. The proposed segmentation approach has been evaluated utilizing three encoder-decoder-based architectures, namely U-net, U-net++, and DeeplabV3+. Its performance is assessed using four metrics such as dice coefficient, Intersection over Union (IoU), precision, and recall. Among the three encoder-decoder-based architectures, DeeplabV3+ outperforms the U-net and U-net++. DeeplabV3+ yields a Dice coefficient of 0.9566 and an IoU of 0.9171 on the training dataset, surpassing the performance of U-net and U-net++.

articleTitle: “Empowering Education: The Role of Artificial Intelligence in Supporting Students with Disabilities”
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Recent Trends in Microelectronics, Automation, Computing and Communications Systems (ICMACC)
abstract: The integration of artificial intelligence (AI) in education has revolutionized adaptive learning technologies and greatly supports the learners with disabilities. This study explores how AI solutions help make education more inclusive by addressing challenges related to mental, visual, and hearing impairments. By reviewing existing research and survey data, we highlight tools like speech-to-text applications, intelligent tutoring systems, and personalized platforms that improve learning experiences for students with disabilities. Key AI tools—such as speech-to-text applications, language translation services, intelligent tutoring systems, and personalized learning platforms—are crucial in meeting the diverse needs of students. Moreover, the study addresses the ethical, technical, and adoption challenges that are associated with the integration of AI in educational settings. These include the issues of privacy, algorithmic bias, and the need for adequate training for educators. The paper offers recommendations for policymakers, educators, and researchers encouraging the development and responsible adoption of these technologies to ensure disabled students have the same academic opportunities as their non-disabled peers. Additionally, the findings highlight the necessity for increased awareness and education on current AI trends for disabled children to maximize the benefits of these technologies. This paper contributes to the ongoing discourse on AI in education and disability studies, advocating for a future where AI-powered adaptive learning technologies empower all students to reach their full potential.

articleTitle: Detecting Credit Card Fraud Using Machine Learning Models
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Recent Trends in Microelectronics, Automation, Computing and Communications Systems (ICMACC)
abstract: Many cases of credit card fraud occur often, this resulting in huge losses. A large share of the proliferation of online transactions in recent years has now been contributed to online credit card transactions. Therefore, credit card fraud detection applications are a valuable and needed instrument for banks and other financial institutions. The numerous kinds and categories of substantive forms of fraudulent transactions make them unique in many ways. Several models employing the machine learning algorithm are employed in combating the fraud and a performance evaluation is carried out to establish the best technique. All in all, in this review a detailed guide is provided as how to select the right algorithm. An appropriate performance matrix is utilized to illustrate proposed method. The study selected the Credit Card Fraud Detection dataset. In performing feature selection, the dataset is split into two datasets, training data and test data and Alert the User when the model predicts the transaction as fraud. Policies implemented in the experiment that adopted algorithms include - Naive Bayes, K Nearest Neighbors, Random Forest, Logistic Regression, SVM and Decision trees. Among all machine learning models random forest outperforms all with the detection accuracy of 94.98%

articleTitle: Process Parameters Optimization for 3D Printed Carbon Fiber Reinforced PLA Composites
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Recent Trends in Microelectronics, Automation, Computing and Communications Systems (ICMACC)
abstract: In the automotive industry, lightweight structures are increasingly incorporated to achieve weight reduction, which enhances component life and performance without compromising quality and durability. The industry continually seeks new lightweight materials that fulfill these requirements and are cost-effective. Additionally, the manufacturing process must be simple and accessible. Additive manufacturing allows manufacturers to produce easily customizable components, including lightweight automotive parts. Polylactic Acid (PLA) is a commonly used thermoplastic suitable for 3D printing. This study examines the mechanical properties of Carbon Fiber (CF) reinforced PLA composites produced using Fused Deposition Modeling (FDM) and analyzes the comparative results determined by varying the printing parameters.

articleTitle: Face Detection and Recognition Based Intelligence Surveillance Robot for Attendance System
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Recent Trends in Microelectronics, Automation, Computing and Communications Systems (ICMACC)
abstract: Proposed paper implements face detection and recognition based video surveillance robot model for attendance system. Proposed paper uses approach that detects and recognizes individual information from predefined database using Haar detection within Wi-Fi connectivity. Proposed paper implements a robot using Raspberry Pi controller and web camera for face detection and face recognition. It uses OpenCV libraries for python and database management system. Proposed method can replace old method of using passwords and minimizes real time human errors. Proposed paper implements robot for moving to different places to detect and recognizes faces in any background. Proposed system is tested on various datasets with various backgrounds and results will validate the accuracy of face recognition method. With its faster and authentic performance, it is suitable for applications of automation, educational institutions, industrial applications etc.

articleTitle: Design Methodology of Radio Frequency Front End Power Amplifier Topologies for Sub-6 GHz Applications
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Recent Trends in Microelectronics, Automation, Computing and Communications Systems (ICMACC)
abstract: The present and future generations of cellular and mobile communications have increased the demand for wireless communication systems with portable size, low power, low cost along multi-functional design specifications. As a result, there is a need for the design of mobile handsets or User Equipment (UE) for emerging sub-6GHz applications with Radio Frequency Front-End (RFFE) to support increased data, more coverage, low power, less area, etc. This paper deals with the design of the RF Power Amplifier (PA) of RFFE. This design covers different RF PA classes from linear PA types i.e., Class A, Class AB, Class B, and Class C to switching PA types i.e., Class D, Class E, and Class F. These amplifiers having non-functional performance metrics with Transistor Technology, Supply Voltage, Gain, Output Power, Noise Figure, Power Added Efficiency (PAE), etc., are analyzed to support future generation systems. The designs are targeted for CMOS 45 nm technology using Cadence Electronic Design Automation (EDA) Virtuoso tool with Analog Design Environment (ADE) simulator for functionality and desired frequency of applications.

articleTitle: Efficient Assembly Line Operations through Machine Vision-Enabled Assembly Part Classification
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Recent Trends in Microelectronics, Automation, Computing and Communications Systems (ICMACC)
abstract: Assembly line complexity presents significant challenges in integrating various systems, subsystems, and mechanical components. Manual inspection of assembled parts often leads to quality assurance issues, potentially resulting in production downtime, cost overruns, and product failures. This research proposes a novel automated machine vision system to address these challenges by identifying and classifying mechanical parts' spatial dimensions in assembly lines. The study compared the results of deep learning techniques. Specifically, Convolutional Neural Networks and ResNet50 are trained on a high-performance computing infrastructure for robust component identification. Our approach achieves a remarkable 99.68% training accuracy, significantly outperforming existing methods. The developed model is deployed for real-time prediction of components in assembly lines, offering a versatile solution applicable across various manufacturing sectors. A key innovation of this study is integrating the deep learning model with a user-friendly Graphical User Interface (GUI), enhancing operator efficiency and reducing human error.
