This research contributes to the field of smart manufacturing by demonstrating the feasibility and effectiveness of AI-driven quality control in complex assembly processes, potentially transforming industrial inspection methodologies.

articleTitle: Performance Comparison of Deep Learning Models for Ultrasound-Based Kidney Disease Diagnosis
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Recent Trends in Microelectronics, Automation, Computing and Communications Systems (ICMACC)
abstract: This paper presents a comparative analysis of three advanced deep learning models, U-Net, SegNet, and DeepLabv3+, to segment anatomical structures of kidneys in ultrasound images to promote the diagnosis of kidney disorders. The models were assessed using essential performance metrics: Sensitivity, Dice Similarity Coefficient (DSC), and Intersection over Union (IoU). In all the parameters, including Dice score, IoU, as well as the Sensitivity, U-Net had higher scores with 0.91, 0.88 and 0.93 respectively. Encoder-decoder configuration connected skip connection means spatial information retention and fine features recovery while making it perfect for accurate kidney segmentation. The whole architecture was tested on the bone class, gaining a Dice score of 0.89, an IoU of 0.85, a Sensitivity of 0.91. The model introduced atrous convolution and atrous spatial pyramid pooling for a better way of handling multiscalar information; however, the model painted out worse performance in perceiving minute structures in comparison to U-net. Nevertheless, SegNet which was the most computationally efficient had the lowest score of a Dice score of 0.85, IoU of 0.81, and sensitivity of 0.87. The reduced performance was caused by a reduction of spatial information during level max-pooling and up-sampling to extract borders of the kidneys. In this paper, it is established that the U-Net architecture is optimal in the context of kidney ultrasound segmentation, demonstrating state-of-the-art performance for clinical applications in kidney disease diagnosis. Future research could focus on other models, different from the pure ones, in order to improve the effectiveness of segmentation.

articleTitle: Event Triggered and Self Triggered Formation Control of Multi Agent Systems
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Recent Trends in Microelectronics, Automation, Computing and Communications Systems (ICMACC)
abstract: This paper discusses formation acquisition and maneuvering of multi agent systems incorporating different triggering mechanisms. Practical scenario often involves limited communication bandwidth. Addressing this limitation is crucial for achieving effective formation control of multi agent systems. Implementing suitable triggering mechanism may overcome this limitations. Event Triggered and Self Triggered strategies employing Lyapunov stability are proposed in this work. In case of event triggered mechanism, an event condition is evaluated to determine the triggered instant, whereas the next triggered instant is anticipated in advance for self triggered mechanism. Simulation results using a five-agent model illustrate the feasibility of the proposed methodologies with self triggered approach having an upper hand in terms of reduction in sensor burden.

articleTitle: Multilingual Voice Based Vending Machine
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Recent Trends in Microelectronics, Automation, Computing and Communications Systems (ICMACC)
abstract: Current vending machines are widespread in public spaces, offering a range of products through visual interfaces and traditional payment methods, such as coins and cards. However, they often lack accessibility features for visually impaired users, who face difficulties navigating menus independently. Additionally, many machines support only a single language, limiting usability for non-native speakers. To address these shortcomings, we propose a Multilingual Voice Based Vending Machine (VBVM) that enhances accessibility and usability. Our system operates via voice commands, enabling visually impaired users to interact with the machine without physical assistance. It supports four languages, ensuring inclusivity for non-native speakers, and includes braille on the keypads for additional accessibility. The VBVM also incorporates flexible payment methods, including both coin-based transactions and cashless payments through the Unified Payments Interface (UPI). By providing a user-friendly, voice-enabled interface and multiple accessibility features, the VBVM aims to offer an inclusive vending experience for all users, regardless of their visual or linguistic capabilities.

articleTitle: User Profile Based Movie Recommender System Using Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Recent Trends in Microelectronics, Automation, Computing and Communications Systems (ICMACC)
abstract: With the abundance of information online, users often struggle to make informed decisions. Recommendation systems (RMS) are crucial for helping users find relevant items among vast choices thereby using Content-Based Filtering and Collaborative Filtering algorithms. These systems are widely used across e-commerce, music apps, and streaming platforms like Netflix and YouTube to enhance user experience and drive business goals. Despite their benefits, RMS face some hazards such as cold start problems and scalability issues, which can impact the quality of recommendations. The proposed method uses the MovieLens-100k dataset, specifically the movies and ratings files, to recommend movies based on Content-Based Filtering. By preprocessing the data and calculating TF-IDF vectors and calculating the similarity for movie genres, the system builds user profiles and recommends movies with high similarity scores. Additionally, Single Value Decomposition (SVD) is used to address issues related to sparsity and scalability in collaborative filtering by reducing dimensionality.

articleTitle: Distributed Data Acquisition: Enhancing Sensor Networks with CAN Over Powerline (DC-BUS) for Efficient and Robust System Integration of Launch Vehicles
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Recent Trends in Microelectronics, Automation, Computing and Communications Systems (ICMACC)
abstract: In traditional launch vehicle systems, a centralized data acquisition approach is followed, where various sensors are directly connected to a data acquisition system (DAQ) which supplies the excitation signal to the sensor and also does the job of filtering, signal conditioning, digitizing and packetization of the sensor signal which is then sent to Telemetry Package which in turn transmits this information to the ground stations via RF Signals. As the sensors and signal processing system are not collocated, there is a large amount of cabling from the sensor to the DAQ with power and signal causing weight penalty and Electromagnetic Interference (EMI) related issues. A failure of DAQ results in disruption of the entire sensor network. A smart sensor approach is reported in literature, in which the team developed a smart sensor integrated with an ADC and Microcontroller which transmits the data over an RS-485 Bus. Though this approach solves some of the aforesaid problems but needs additional powerlines distribution and suffers from undefined protocol. This paper proposes the use of Controller Area Network (CAN) Over Powerline (DC-BUS) bus for supplying power and acquiring data from the sensors and distributing the data acquisition resulting in a more reliable and robust sensor network for Launch Vehicles.

articleTitle: Development of a Verilog-Based System for Pattern Detection Using Convolutional Neural Networks
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Recent Trends in Microelectronics, Automation, Computing and Communications Systems (ICMACC)
abstract: Pattern detection is a foundational element in computer vision, crucial for advancements in autonomous driving, surveillance, and numerous other fields. Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs) have significantly enhanced pattern detection by improving both accuracy and efficiency. This paper aims to develop a Verilog-based system for pattern detection using CNNs, focusing on detecting and counting occurrences of a specified test pattern within input images. The CNN architecture employs Convolutional Layers for feature extraction and Max Pooling Layers for spatial downsampling, both essential in image processing. Through iterative weight adjustments during training, the CNN learns to recognize patterns similar to the test pattern. After training, the system evaluates unseen images, predicting the presence and count of test pattern instances. To optimize performance, the system incorporates approximate adders to reduce area and gate count, thereby enhancing efficiency. These optimizations enable the system to achieve high performance while maintaining computational efficiency, providing detection and counting of specified patterns in images. This capability offers valuable insights and practical solutions for various real-world applications.

articleTitle: An Evaluation Utilizing on the Web Metric Analytics of the Selected Institutes of Medical Sciences Library Website
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Recent Trends in Microelectronics, Automation, Computing and Communications Systems (ICMACC)
abstract: The current investigation looks into the websites of Tamil Nadu Medical Institutes and the All Sciences library. Several web analysis tools were used in the study to assess the library websites systematic to determine the website domain structure, Google Page Rank, number of visitors, internal and external links, Google Page Speed Insights (PSI), and Web Impact Factor (WIF) of the selected medical institute library websites. Even so, it also needs to be mentioned that, of the fifteen Medical Institutes with library websites, the performance of these websites is further acceptable. SRIHER, Chennai has the highest WIF of any of the institutions, while CARE, Kanchipuram, and SIMATS, Chennai have the highest Google Page Ranking scores.

articleTitle: Application of CNN-RF Models for Enhanced Serve Shot Classification in Table Tennis
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Recent Trends in Microelectronics, Automation, Computing and Communications Systems (ICMACC)
abstract: In this research, a novel CNN-RF model is proposed to enhance serve shot strategies in table tennis. Combination of sift, detect and segment capability of CNNs with the maximum accurate classification capacity of RFs help to assess serving characters including the trajectory of the ball, direction of spin and movement patterns of players. This proposed model achieved an average accuracy of 92.5% which is quite higher than classic CNN-only (87.3%) and RF-only (82.1%).Using k=5 of Cross-validation, it was eliciting a standard deviation of ±1.2% this shows how stable the model is after partitioning the data. The model demonstrated good predictive capabilities: The accuracy of the model was at 91.8% and the recall was at 93.1%, and the F1 score at 92.4%. A feature relevance analysis done revealed that ball spin direction, serve speed and player movement explained serve success at 35%, 27 % and 20% respectively. The model was additionally tested with a confusion matrix, it classified topspin serves at 95% accuracy, backspin serves at 90%, and no-spin serves at 86%. These results support the ability of the model to correctly categorize between different serve kinds with fairly high accuracy. The hybrid CNN-RF model has large practical implications that sample actionable information for improving training programs and real-time service ways. Thus, the finding of this study is that the CNN-RF model can be regarded as a more accurate and consistent means of serve shot analysis in comparison with traditional methods; moreover, the method has the most prospects for the development of other sports' metrics assessment.

articleTitle: Enhancing Sarcasm Detection with Contextual Features Through Multi Layered Perceptron Model
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Recent Trends in Microelectronics, Automation, Computing and Communications Systems (ICMACC)
abstract: Sarcasm Detection is a challenging task due to its often nuanced and context-dependent nature. Sarcasm detection has emerged as a critical area in natural language processing, finding applications in sentiment analysis, social media monitoring and customer feedback analysis. The proposed model focuses on the advancing the accuracy and robustness of sarcasm detection model by integrating contextual features and employing sophisticated neural network architecture. The primary objective of the proposed work is to analyze textual data and obtain the best possible features. Features such as sarcasymbols, attenuation indicators and selective stopwords are carefully selected to enhance the model's ability to detect subtle sarcasm cues. By utilizing vector representation of textual data, extracted features and deep neural network, the proposed model identifies sarcasm from textual data. To evaluate the performance of the approaches in the proposed model, the metrics F1-Score and accuracy are used. The proposed model resulted in an impressive accuracy and F1 Score for the binary classification problem in bifurcating the text as sarcastic and non-sarcastic with 86.31 and 87.17 percentages respectively.

articleTitle: DC-DC Converter for Electric Vehicles Based on PV with MPPT
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Recent Trends in Microelectronics, Automation, Computing and Communications Systems (ICMACC)
abstract: By cutting down on pollution and reliance on fossil fuels, electric vehicles may make a big difference in the worldwide battle against climate change. Modern electric vehicles require low-voltage and high-voltages and attained using separate DC-DC converters. In Electric vehicle applications, the prior multiport converters had a higher quantity of energy storage and switching electronics. This article suggests a solution to these problems by proposing a charging circuit for EVs that uses a multiport DC-DC converter. Photovoltaic systems are gaining significance as a vital source of environmentally friendly and sustainable energy. This research investigates the functioning of a boost-buck converter, specifically a Photovoltaic system fed DC-DC converter with twin outputs and one input. The converter has been equipped with perturb and observe algorithms to execute the maximum power point tracking approach. Simulink model for PV modules with different irradiation in MATLAB/Simulink was created to assess the theoretical investigations.

Author Keywords: Single Input Dual Output Photovoltaic systems

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of UNet for Offroad Rover Navigation
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Recent Trends in Microelectronics, Automation, Computing and Communications Systems (ICMACC)
abstract: Significant logistical obstacles arise when delivering supplies to deep forest and off-road trails, which frequently cause access to isolated and deep forest areas to be delayed. An autonomous off-road delivery rover outfitted with UNet. An U-shaped Convolutional Neural Network (CNN), for navigation and obstacle avoidance, is the novel approach to put out this research. The rover's autonomous navigation of rough terrain guarantees that medical supplies reach far-off places on schedule. With an emphasis on UNet's function in navigation and obstacle and route detection, this paper describes the autonomous rover's development, integration and evaluation. Details are provided regarding the rover's hardware, software, and UNet-based navigation module architecture. Furthermore, the concepts of UNet and how it was modified for off-road navigation, such as data gathering and preprocessing.

articleTitle: Gamified Rehabilitation and Physiotherapy Using MediaPipe for Posture and Hand Gesture Recognition
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Recent Trends in Microelectronics, Automation, Computing and Communications Systems (ICMACC)
abstract: Introduction: Rehabilitation for conditions affecting mobility, such as stroke, muscle atrophy, and others, poses significant challenges in traditional physiotherapy practices. Engaging patients in enjoyable exercises is crucial for maintaining compliance with rehabilitation protocols. In response, this paper introduces a pioneering game-based approach to rehabilitation, leveraging posture detection technology. Materials and Methods: A game-based rehabilitation system was developed utilizing deep learning techniques through the MediaPipe framework for posture and hand gesture recognition. The system analyzes user posture in real time via a webcam and translates these movements into game controls, allowing patients to interact with popular games like Subway Surfers to simulate physical activities such as running and jumping. Latency between patient movements and in-game responses was measured across three hardware configurations (8GB, 12GB, and 16GB RAM) to evaluate system performance and responsiveness. Results and Discussion: Latency decreased with higher RAM, with the lowest measured at 430 ms on a 16GB configuration. This real-time responsiveness enhances patient engagement, making the rehabilitation process more immersive and effective. By leveraging posture detection technology, this innovative system bridges the gap between the necessity of rehabilitation exercises and the appeal of gaming, offering a promising solution for improving treatment outcomes across diverse age groups and conditions.

articleTitle: Advanced Cardiac Signal Processing with Federated Learning and IoT for Remote Health Monitoring
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Recent Trends in Microelectronics, Automation, Computing and Communications Systems (ICMACC)
abstract: Cardiovascular diseases are now ranked among the leading causes of death; medical care requires efficient, immediate cardiac monitoring devices. This study provides an original approach incorporating Federated Learning (FL) with IoT-funded wearable devices for raw cardiac signal processing in real-time, aiming to avoid privacy problems and reduce time delay associated with centralized approaches. In this study, the performance of the developed system was evaluated using the two ECG databases that are freely available in the public domain, the MIT-BIH Arrhythmia Database and the PhysioNet Challenge Database. This proposed model achieved a performance of 97.8<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">%</sup> in detecting cardiac disorders such as arrhythmias and atrial fibrillations. However, measuring by accuracy, it scored 96.5% overall accuracy while concerning the recall, it scored 98.2%, which accounted for an F1 measure of 97.3% overall score. By minimizing latency, the architecture offered a 35% improvement over the traditional centralized CM systems, which makes it very suitable for real-time monitoring. By applying differential privacy methods, the privacy loss parameter was set to ε = 1.5, thus ensuring the privacy of sensitive patient data. The study demonstrates how the proposed system provides a privacy-preserving, real-time, and scalable approach to monitoring heart health, making it a valuable contribution to biomedical signal processing. Current work shall focus on expanding the above model to other biological signals and improving its performance for more widespread use in clinical medicine.

articleTitle: Design of Sigma-Delta Modulator for Medical Implantable Device Using 180nm Technology
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Recent Trends in Microelectronics, Automation, Computing and Communications Systems (ICMACC)
abstract: A first order sigma-delta modulator which is the fundamental building block of sigma-delta analog-to-digital converter is designed in this paper. Sigma-Delta Modulator is widely used in biomedical applications due to their high resolution and low power consumption, especially important for portable or battery operated implantable devices. The modulator is designed to minimize power usage to extend battery life or reduce heat generation. Sigma-Delta Modulator includes Integrator, comparator, D-flip flop and 1 bit DAC as a feedback loop. A Two stage OTA is designed and implemented which is used for designing the component of Sigma Delta Modulator such as Switched-Capacitor Integrator. Sigma Delta Modulator is simulated in 180nm CMOS technology with supply voltage of 1.8 V in cadence virtuoso tool.

articleTitle: Enhancing PVD Process Control Through LabVIEW Automation
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Recent Trends in Microelectronics, Automation, Computing and Communications Systems (ICMACC)
abstract: In this research work, a novel Virtual Instrument (VI) for process control, monitoring, and data acquisition was created using Laboratory Virtual Instrument Engineering Workbench (LabVIEW) software, distinguishing traditional hardware instrumentation from Virtual Instruments. A High-Power Impulse Magnetron Sputtering (HiPIMS) Physical Vapour Deposition (PVD) system has been developed to deposit coatings on a variety of substrates by controlling the process and related subsystems via graphical programming in the LabVIEW environment. It automates the thin film deposition process by sequentially controlling the integrated subsystems. The program also regulates the critical thin film deposition process parameters, including deposition pressure, substrate temperature, substrate rotation, and substrate bias. An upstream pressure control and Proportional Integral Derivative (PID) function to achieve the desired pressure. The results showed accurate pressure control (± 0.0005 mbar) within an operating range of 5×10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-3</sup> - 5×10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-2</sup> mbar. Furthermore, the deposited thin films demonstrated good repeatability and reliability. The presented results will be valuable in developing indigenous custom-made vacuum or PVD systems.

articleTitle: Path Generation Techniques for Multi-Direction and Nonplanar Additive Manufacturing with an Industrial Robot
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Recent Trends in Microelectronics, Automation, Computing and Communications Systems (ICMACC)
abstract: A conventional Additive Manufacturing(AM) system always deposits the material in the direction of gravity. It requires support structures to print overhangs and produces staircase effects since the curved surfaces are approximated with parallel planes. A traditional AM system has three axes, where the material is deposited in the XY plane, and the print bed goes down in the Z direction upon printing one layer. In a gantry-type AM machine, the print head is stationary, and it can't orient. A multi-axis AM system can deposit the material in different directions and attain continuous curved paths. This paper presents the path generation methods for Multidirection and nonplanar robotic AM to eliminate support structures and staircase effects.

articleTitle: Design and Analysis of Axial Flux Permanent Magnet Synchronous Machine
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Recent Trends in Microelectronics, Automation, Computing and Communications Systems (ICMACC)
abstract: The Axial Flux Machines (AFM) are of novel machine topology and offer the advantages of compactness, high power density, and higher efficiency over the conventional Radial Flux Machines (RFM). These machines have complex construction and hence, their design and analysis need a special attention. In this paper, the sizing equations of an Axial Flux Permanent Magnet Synchronous Machine (AFPMSM) have been utilized for its design and the machine parameters have been identified. The mathematical machine model is obtained using d-q transformation and analysis has been carried out for different operating conditions.

articleTitle: Enhanced Breast Tumor Detection with a CNN-LSTM Hybrid Approach: Advancing Accuracy and Precision
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Recent Trends in Microelectronics, Automation, Computing and Communications Systems (ICMACC)
abstract: Since most breast cancers can be treated, early detection and accurate disease classification are critical. This paper introduces the architecture of a new model developed by integrating a Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) and a Long Short-Term Memory (LSTM) under the federated learning model. The objective is to categorize breast cancers into five distinct categories accurately: They include benign, malignant, cystic, fibroadenoma, and phyllodes tumors. A pervasive and comprehensive set of data was gathered to evaluate five different medical institutes. Relative to the entail standard CNN model, our model achieved a high accuracy level of 93%. 0%, precision of 92. 5%, Recall of 93. Specifically, Accuracy was at 0%, and an F1-score of 92-7%. Meanwhile, the other traditional CNN models obtained an average accuracy of 88. 5%, precision of 87. 9%, Recall of 88. 47%, while the corresponding Recall for the proposed method is 92. 54% in class 0, 66. 67% in classes 1, 7. 50 % in class 2, and F1-score is 81. 0%. This made it possible for the universities to cooperate in developing the systems while maintaining the confidentiality of data, an essential factor in the medical field. An ablation study focused on the importance of each component; specifically, the CNN-LSTM model achieved a 92%-5% accuracy with a plain Abi word list without federated learning and 93 0% with its inclusion. However, the research also understands limitations; for example, the dataset is small, and adding FL requires extra computation.

articleTitle: SVM Based Fault Detection Scheme of an Aircraft Actuator
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Recent Trends in Microelectronics, Automation, Computing and Communications Systems (ICMACC)
abstract: This paper proposes and presents a fault detection strategy for an aircraft actuator model. The approach is designed to detect faults in the presence of process and measurement noises. The work encompasses three fault detection schemes: (i) Machine learning-based fault detection, (ii) Observer-based fault detection, and (iii) Extended Kalman Filter-based detection. The observer design relies on solving a set of Linear Matrix Inequalities (LMIs), which can be efficiently handled using Matlab's LMI toolbox. The Extended Kalman Filter is employed due to the system's nonlinearity and noises in process as well as measurement. Faults are indicated when residuals deviate from zero and exceed a threshold value. In the machine learning-based scheme, Support Vector Machine (SVM) technology is used to detect and isolate two common types of faults of actuators. The simulation results compare these three techniques under conditions of nonlinear uncertainties, external faults, and noise in the aircraft actuator.

articleTitle: Mitigating Credit Card Fraud: A Machine Learning Perspective
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Recent Trends in Microelectronics, Automation, Computing and Communications Systems (ICMACC)
abstract: In this day and age of online and digital transactions, credit cards have come up as a popular option of payment. This has led to the increase in the fraudulent credit card transactions and as a result the banks and the customers have to bear the loss. It is very vital for the credit card companies to identify and stop the fraud transactions. The main aim of this project is to create a model that can distinguish fraudulent credit card transactions from real ones. The proposed model uses the transaction patterns of previous credit card transaction data which contains both genuine and fraud data to train itself using suitable ML algorithms and identify the fraudulent transactions and nip it in the bud. We will be using using SMOTE to process the data considering the imbalance between legitimate and fraudulent transactions, hyperparameter tuning the model for increased effectiveness and using random forest classifier and decision tree classifier to compare results. By using the above mentioned techniques we saw an increase in accuracy and recall. These models offer a scaleable solution to the problem of real time fraud detection in an ever growing and vast financial landscape

articleTitle: IOT Based Electric Vehicle with Real Time Monitoring and Accident Detection
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Recent Trends in Microelectronics, Automation, Computing and Communications Systems (ICMACC)
abstract: The creation of an Internet of Things (IoT)-enabled electric vehicle (EV) with a sophisticated monitoring system is presented in this study. The project monitors environmental variables and vehicle dynamics in real-time using an ESP32 microcontroller and a variety of sensors, such as temperature/humidity, gas, fire, crash, ultrasonic, and accelerometer sensors. The EV can be remotely monitored and controlled using the Telegram messaging service and the Blynk mobile application. Techniques include setting up hardware, integrating sensors, implementing software, establishing communication protocols, and testing. Findings show the system's efficacy and dependability in practical situations, opening the door to more intelligent and safe transportation options.

articleTitle: Smart Electric Vehicle Monitoring System Using ESP8266 and Raspberry Pi with Azure Services
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Recent Trends in Microelectronics, Automation, Computing and Communications Systems (ICMACC)
abstract: Electric Vehicles can serve several purposes. Monitoring these EVs may optimize their performance. The main parameters to be monitored include Speed, Distance, Battery level (%), GPS, Temperature, and Gas. Here speed is monitored to avoid rash driving on campus, Distance is monitored to estimate the service time using an Odometer, battery level is monitored to optimize the battery charge cycle, GPS is monitored to locate the vehicle, the temperature is monitored to the environment of EV, and finally Gas is monitored to whether there are any leakage of gas or burning of battery in EV. ESP8266 is used to read all the parameters mentioned earlier from various sensors. ThingSpeak cloud is used to monitor the speed of vehicles through a virtual speedometer and the push bullet application is used to send notifications when the vehicle is over-speeding also ESP8266 sends sensor data to Raspberry Pi using serial communication which acts as a gateway and sends it to Azure cloud for data analysis, visualization of each parameter using the Power BI which plays a crucial role to give service alerts to the vehicle owner.

articleTitle: Rainfall Prediction Using Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Recent Trends in Microelectronics, Automation, Computing and Communications Systems (ICMACC)
abstract: The title is “Rainfall Prediction Using Machine Learning”. The initiative's dataset is written in Python and stored in Microsoft Excel. A wide range of machine learning algorithms are used to discover which strategy generates the best accurate predictions. In many sections of the country, rainfall forecasting is critical for avoiding major natural disasters. This forecast was created using a variety of machine learning approaches, including catboost, xgboost, decision tree, random forest, logistic regression, neural network, and light gbm. It incorporates several components. The Weather Dataset was utilized. The primary goal of the research is to evaluate a variety of algorithms and determine which one performs best. Farmers may greatly profit from growing the appropriate crops based on the amount of water they require.

Author Keywords: Machine learning algorithms include the catboost

articleTitle: Big Data Applications for Sustainable Generation of Official Statistical Indicators - A Systematic
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Recent Trends in Microelectronics, Automation, Computing and Communications Systems (ICMACC)
abstract: The well-accepted concept, big data has left no stone unturned with respect to its sustainable applications in diverse sectors. Usage of big data by National Statistical Organizations (NSOs) to generate official statistics through automation is one of such significant domains. To encourage the stakeholders and to tap the benefits of automation using big data in generating official statistics, via sustainable means, present study reviewed the articles in a systematic manner. A range of articles are selected from global digital libraries and are filtered for relevance as well as quality of content. Final list of selected articles is further reviewed to address the proposed research question. Thus, the current study provides information in the form of articles that furnish valuable insights about big data sources for producing official statistical indicators. The study disclosed many benefits of big data, ensuring the sustainability in generating official statistical indicators like internet data usage to estimate Consumer Price Index (CPI); satellite imagery data for agriculture census; Population mobility and tourism statistics using mobile phone location data; and traffic statistics using traffic sensors data and so on.

articleTitle: Real- Time Compressed Domain Face Recognition Using Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Recent Trends in Microelectronics, Automation, Computing and Communications Systems (ICMACC)
abstract: The growing demand for facial recognition systems necessitates efficient processing of images, particularly in resource-constrained environments. Compressed images offer a significant advantage in terms of storage and transmission bandwidth, but traditional face recognition algorithms struggle with the information loss inherent in compression techniques like JPEG. This paper explores the feasibility of using a VGG-16 based approach for real-time face recognition directly in the compressed domain. We leverage transfer learning by fine-tuning a pretrained VGG-16 model on a dataset of compressed facial images. This approach capitalizes on the powerful feature extraction capabilities of VGG-16 while adapting it to the challenges of compressed images, such as artifacts and information loss. Our evaluation demonstrates that the trained model achieves accurate face recognition using compressed images, paving the way for real-world applications with bandwidth and storage limitations. Future work could involve exploring the impact of different compression techniques on recognition accuracy and potentially improving robustness against compression artifacts. This work acknowledges the inherent tradeoff between the compression ratio of images and the achievable recognition accuracy. In this thesis, we are investigating this relationship to identify the optimal balance between storage efficiency and recognition performance for real-world deployments.

articleTitle: Comprehensive Integration and Implementation of Air Quality Monitoring Technology for Respiratory Health in Cardiovascular and Asthmatic Individuals
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Recent Trends in Microelectronics, Automation, Computing and Communications Systems (ICMACC)
abstract: One of the most alarming concerns in today's world is air pollution, which affects individuals' health and respiratory systems. The burning of agricultural residues and the excessive use of unconditioned vehicles result in the emission of harmful gases such as methane, carbon monoxide, carbon dioxide, ammonia, and oxides of nitrogen and sulfur. These pollutants can lead to respiratory and cardiovascular diseases in humans. To address this issue, a smart air pollution monitoring system based on the Internet of Things (IoT) was developed to track air quality and notify individuals when concentrations exceed acceptable levels as recommended by reliable sources. This system uses portable gas sensors (MQ2 for detecting smoke and combustible gases like methane and butane, and MQ135 for detecting ammonia, benzene, carbon dioxide, and other harmful gases) and microcontroller boards such as Arduino Uno and ESP32. The sensor data is transmitted to a webpage via the ESP32 Wi-Fi module, and the concentration of gases is displayed on an LCD. A buzzer alerts individuals when concentrations surpass permissible levels. The proposed system was tested to detect concentration of gases in indoor environment and the corresponding concentration values have been discussed. However, the system can also be extended for usage in industrial and mining areas where there is a possibility of severe air contamination.

articleTitle: Utilization of Non-Orthogonal Multiple Access (NOMA) for Spectral Efficiency in Mixed Fading Environments
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Recent Trends in Microelectronics, Automation, Computing and Communications Systems (ICMACC)
abstract: We explore in this paper a potential application of Non-Orthogonal Multiple Access (NOMA) to improve spectral efficiency in multi-fading environments that are ubiquitous in wireless communication systems. This is enabled by NOMA, which distributes the transmit power over different users according to their channel conditions and effectively utilizes the spectrum resources. The performance of NOMA is evaluated by extensive simulations and analytical results are provided to analyze the gains of NOMA over Orthogonal Multiple Access (OMA) in various fading models such as Rayleigh, Rician, and Nakagami-m. The following key metrics including Spectral Efficiency, Bit Error Rate (BER), Capacity, Outage Probability, Throughput and Cumulative Distribution Function (CDF) of User Rates are analyzed to measure the performance gains provided by NOMA for system throughput improvement, reduced errors, support for additional users as well as a fair resource allocation. Simulation results show the superiority of NOMA technique in comparison to OMA, especially for high density users and different channel models, making NOMA an important candidate as a future radio access scheme.

articleTitle: Smart Water Management in Agriculture: IoT Solutions for Reducing Water Consumption
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Recent Trends in Microelectronics, Automation, Computing and Communications Systems (ICMACC)
abstract: A problem that is escalating on a global level and demands fresh approaches to improve the use of water resources is water scarcity. This research examines the potential of IoT-based Smart Water Management Systems (SWMS) in addressing these challenges through real-time data for water supply, leak detection and quality checks. Five case studies showed that IoT systems reduced total water use by 25 per cent and cut NRW by 30 per cent due to leakage detection. Irrigation technologies in agriculture, for instance, have cut water use by 20% to 35% productivity and raised crop yields by about 15%. The study demonstrates IoT impact and its significance to water quality by exploiting IoT's sensors, which, according to the survey, scored 98% in pollution identification; this was enough to meet safety laws in a 95% sample of the inspected territories. Due to monitoring and condition prediction capabilities, urban water supply systems' availability and reliability improved by 22%. Using IoT for water management in Singapore resulted in better water loss, down to 28%, while in rural Indian regions, IoT irrigation improved water saving by 30%. The following statistical results focus on IoT's transformative capability in developing water resource management. In future strategies for water management, the report advises that IoT should be complemented with high-end data analysis and artificial intelligence.

articleTitle: Innovative IoT-Driven Smart Agro Incubator System
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Recent Trends in Microelectronics, Automation, Computing and Communications Systems (ICMACC)
abstract: The integration of technology in agriculture has become increasingly essential in the contemporary era, driven by the imperative for sustainable practices and efficient resource management. Addressing these needs, the proposed Smart Agro Incubator leverages the ESP32 microcontroller, renowned for its robust capabilities, including integrated Wi-Fi and Bluetooth functionalities. Central to its mission, the Smart Agro Incubator seeks to revolutionize the germination and early growth stages of plants by delivering precise environmental control and real-time monitoring. This is achieved through a sophisticated system that harnesses the power of various sensors and actuators, all managed seamlessly by the ESP32 microcontroller. Key sensors deployed within the incubator continuously monitor critical environmental parameters such as temperature, humidity, light intensity, and soil moisture. This real-time data is fed into the ESP32, which dynamically regulates the incubator's conditions through a network of actuators. These actuators, including heaters, fans, and water pumps, are precisely controlled to maintain optimal growth conditions tailored to the specific needs of the plants being cultivated. One of the standout features of the Smart Agro Incubator is its seamless integration with modern communication technologies to its built-in Wi-Fi connectivity, the incubator can be remotely monitored and controlled via a smartphone application or web interface. This level of accessibility empowers farmers and growers to stay informed about the environmental conditions within the incubator from anywhere, at any time. Moreover, it allows for swift adjustments to be made to the settings, ensuring that the growth conditions remain optimal for maximum yield and quality. The Smart Agro Incubator represents a cutting-edge solution at the intersection of agriculture and technology. By leveraging the ESP32 microcontroller's capabilities and integrating advanced sensors and communication technologies, it offers a pathway to more efficient and sustainable agricultural practices, ultimately driving higher yields and ensuring food security for future generations.

articleTitle: Enhancing Lung Cancer Detection using VGG-16: Leveraging Deep Convolutional Neural Networks for Accurate Medical Image Analysis
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Recent Trends in Microelectronics, Automation, Computing and Communications Systems (ICMACC)
abstract: Lung cancer is one of the deadliest diseases a person can face. The course of medical treatment depends largely on the cancer's type and location. Early detection of cancer cells could save countless lives. To achieve this, an automated system is needed to identify malignant conditions as quickly as possible. Although many techniques have been proposed by researchers over the years, prediction accuracy remains a significant challenge. This paper introduces a method based on artificial neural networks to detect abnormal lung tissue growth. To enhance accuracy, a tool with a higher probability of detection is utilized. Medical professionals diagnose patients using histological images of biopsied tissue from potentially infected lungs. However, diagnosing various types of lung cancer is time-consuming and prone to error. Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs) have improved the speed and accuracy of identifying and classifying different types of lung cancer, leading to better patient outcomes by helping identify the most effective treatment options. For this study, we used the “Histopathological Images” dataset from Kaggle, which includes lung adenocarcinomas, lung squamous cell carcinomas, and normal lung tissues. The key stages of this approach involve model selection, evaluation, pre-processing, and data collection. Metrics such as accuracy, precision, recall, and Fl-score were used to assess the proposed method. The CNN model achieved accuracy rates of 97.5% for training and 98.5% for validation.

articleTitle: A 1-kS/s Sampled 8-Bit SAR ADC for Sensing Block in Pacemaker
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Recent Trends in Microelectronics, Automation, Computing and Communications Systems (ICMACC)
abstract: This paper presents an 8-bit Successive Approximation Register Analog-to-Digital Converter (SAR ADC) designed in Cadence Virtuoso utilizing 180nm 1.8V CMOS technology making it suitable for integration into modern pacemaker devices. The design focuses on low-power consumption and accurate conversion of cardiac signals for reliable pacemaker operation. The proposed architecture comprises four key blocks: a bootstrap switch for reduced switching power, an efficient DAC switching scheme, a two-stage CMOS dynamic comparator for high-speed and low-power comparison, and a SAR logic circuit for controlling the conversion process. Simulation results demonstrate the ADC component's ability to achieve reduction in power consumption for sample and hold circuit to 13.54nW (dynamic power) and 4.35pW (static power) at capacitive load of 11pF. Two-stage CMOS dynamic comparator achieves power consumption at pre amplifier stage of 18.08μW and at latch stage of 108.4nW while maintaining a small footprint, making it a promising candidate for next-generation pacemakers.

articleTitle: Identification of Glaucoma Using Deep Learning: A Systematic Literature Review
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Recent Trends in Microelectronics, Automation, Computing and Communications Systems (ICMACC)
abstract: Retinal abnormalities impact millions of individuals globally. Timely identification and intervention in these abnormalities have the potential to halt their progression, thereby preventing countless individuals from experiencing avoidable blindness. Glaucoma is a condition characterized by the damage to the optic nerve in the eye. Typically, this occurs when there is an accumulation of fluid in the front portion of the eye, leading to increased intraocular pressure. The elevated pressure adversely affects the optic nerve, resulting in damage. Glaucoma emerges as a primary cause of blindness among individuals aged 60 and above. However, timely intervention can frequently prevent blindness associated with glaucoma through early treatment. The manual detection of ocular diseases is known for being time-consuming, & lacking in repeatability. In response, there have been initiatives to automate the detection of such diseases, leveraging the success of applying Deep Convolutional Neural Networks (DCNNs) for Computer-Aided Diagnosis (CAD). While these models have demonstrated effectiveness, challenges persist due to the intricate nature of retinal lesions. This study provides an introduction of popular imaging modalities, critically examines existing deep-learning techniques for glaucoma detection & grading, and focuses on the Systematic Literature Review (SLR) of the most prominent retinal diseases.

articleTitle: Towards Improved Speech Enhancement:Parameter Optimization in the Scalart Wiener Filter Method
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Recent Trends in Microelectronics, Automation, Computing and Communications Systems (ICMACC)
abstract: Communication in noisy environments demands efficient noise suppression techniques due to reduced intelligibility and listener fatigue. This research optimizes the Decision-Directed Wiener filter for speech enhancement by meticulously adjusting the smoothing factor (alpha) and noise updating parameter (NoiseLength), crucial for adaptive performance across diverse acoustic settings. Using the Noizeus dataset, a thorough evaluation was conducted to assess how varying these parameters impacts speech enhancement quality. The proposed adjustments were rigorously evaluated using objective metrics such as Perpetual Evaluation of Speech Quality(PESQ), Normalized Cross-correlation Metric (NCM), and Signal-to-Noise Ratio (SNR), offering a comprehensive assessment of speech enhancement quality. These metrics collectively offer insights into speech enhancement quality. Findings show that fine-tuning alpha and NoiseLength parameters significantly improve speech quality, underscoring their critical role in optimizing the Decision-Directed Wiener filter. With the optimal settings, the enhancements led to an average increase of 19.72% in Perpetual Evaluation of Speech Quality (PESQ), 17.68% in Normalized Cross-correlation Metric (NCM), and 59.35% in Signal-to-Noise Ratio (SNR), demonstrating the effectiveness of the parameter adjustments.

articleTitle: Breast Cancer Segmentation Using U-NET Architecture
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Recent Trends in Microelectronics, Automation, Computing and Communications Systems (ICMACC)
abstract: Breast cancer today continues to be a worthy global health concern because its early diagnosis has effective treatment means that make it come with efficient diagnostic techniques. In this paper, a new procedure is proposed to deal with breast ultrasound image segmentation with an intention of improving the identification of breast cancer lesions. The proposed methodology is built upon aU-NET architcture, a CNN structure in an encoderdecoder fashion along with skip connections; it concentrates on accurate segmentation of the specific pathologies in the ultrasound images. The dataset used incorporate breast ultrasound images which are a verydiverse collection and are thoroughly labeled for segmentation ground truth. Cross Entropy loss and Dice loss is used as the loss functions for the training process, fine-tuned with the Adam optimizer. The robustness of this method is evident through various segmentation results based on the experiment performed on different portions of the dataset; the high value of 0.72 of the dice coefficients and a test accuracy of 93% also signal viability of this work. It also establishes the possibility of deep learning approaches for breast cancer detection by using the automatic image processing. Looking at this research from this perspective will also expand the understanding of its applicability in clinical practice which, in turn, may benefit patient prognosis relying on radiologists' support in cancer detection at early stages. This research lays the foundation for the possible future studies of more complex deep learning networks in breast ultrasound imagery and offers hope for the improved diagnostic methods in this field and, in consequence, better treatment options for patients.

articleTitle: Enhancing Security: A Hybrid Encryption Algorithm for Effective Key Generation
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Recent Trends in Microelectronics, Automation, Computing and Communications Systems (ICMACC)
abstract: The abstract Data security is of most importance, in the present day- the introduction of high-level wireless communication channels has led to generation and transfer of massive amounts of data. Data security must keep up with it. Data breach may cause disastrous outcomes. Previously, hardware security modules (HSM) were used to perform cryptographic actions- storing keys and for authentication. This is no longer feasible as HSMs are physical devices and become inconvenient to carry around all the time. The unavailability of HSM poses a serious security threat (for cryptographic keys). This paper aims at a novel software solution that compensates for hardware. As the algorithm focuses on securing keys used for encryption. It may be referred to as key security scheme (KSS). The paper proposes a way to generate keys instead of storing it and assumes performing of cryptographic actions on the available hardware in the system. The proposed method can secure data, both in transit and while at rest.

articleTitle: Design and Development of IoT-Based Smart Tea Vending Machine
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Recent Trends in Microelectronics, Automation, Computing and Communications Systems (ICMACC)
abstract: In the modern world, there is a great demand for automated vending machines. The lack of sophisticated features and increased maintenance and repair costs of the current vending machines make the inclusion of intelligence necessary. To ensure simple maintenance and defect detection, a new smart tea vending machine is designed and developed in this work by integrating a variety of sensors. To allow real-time monitoring of system characteristics including material availability, temperature, sensor values, and other status data, the machine is connected to the cloud through IoT. A real-time fault detection approach is also used in this study to find errors that occur during operation. For easy and rapid maintenance, these issues are reported to the manufacturer or service providers. Each sensor defect has been identified by an integer number, where each number denotes the problems associated with a certain sensor or actuator. This architecture gives the vendor the ability to track the machine's status and sensor data globally. The designed system can therefore be referred to as a Smart IoT-enabled Vending Machine that offers a cost-effective solution with improving efficiency, simple fault detection, customer satisfaction, and raising the demand for the mass adoption of IoT-based Smart Vending Machines.

articleTitle: Real Time Object Detection of Vehicles and Labeling Using the YOLOv5 Method
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Recent Trends in Microelectronics, Automation, Computing and Communications Systems (ICMACC)
abstract: Vehicle detection aimed to enhance road safety. Traffic monitoring challenges for vehicle detection and labeling. The existing methodologies are techniques that run time struggle with real-world scenarios. We applied the YOLOv5 model for vehicle detection and labeling using this model, which detects the vehicle types and labeling. In the area of Artificial Intelligence, image processing and computer vision. These are the major categories of classification for group object detection. We applied the YOLOv5 model standalone application in this paper for real-time object detection. Using this architecture, the process data configures the file and detects the objects. We have taken two scenarios: finding the sweeping vehicles and the cars labeling them. In future, it will be extended to provide an intelligent vehicle detection and monitoring.

articleTitle: Intelligent Framework to Detection of Fake Review Using Machine Learning Algorithms
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Recent Trends in Microelectronics, Automation, Computing and Communications Systems (ICMACC)
abstract: Online reviews are becoming a more important resource for consumers as they make purchasing decisions. Recent years have seen a rise in the importance of the study fields of social media, hotel reviews, and e-commerce websites. People's decisions are influenced by online reviews. The bogus review has an impact on both consumers and commercial organizations in day-to-day existence. Inflated ratings and fake reviews paint a false picture of a product or service and are intended to mislead consumers away from or towards that product or service. In this research paper, machine learning algorithms are used for detecting fake reviews. The prevalence of fake reviews on online platforms has become a major concern, making it difficult for customers to trust the reviews they read. In this study, we used a dataset of Yelp Chicago restaurants' online reviews and applied various techniques of machine learning to identify phony reviews. The algorithms used included Naive Bayes, Random Forest, Linear SVM, and NN. The performance was evaluated for the models based on F1-score, recall, precision, and accuracy. Our results show that fake reviews can be detected effectively with high accuracy with the help of machine learning algorithms. This study provides a useful framework for identifying fake reviews on online platforms and can help improve the credibility and trustworthiness of online reviews.

articleTitle: Real-Time Cardiac Health Monitoring and Abnormality Alert Systems: Integrating IoT and AI for Enhanced Diagnostic Accuracy
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Recent Trends in Microelectronics, Automation, Computing and Communications Systems (ICMACC)
abstract: Heart diseases have become one of the leading causes of mortality worldwide. Early detection and continuous monitoring of heart health can significantly improve patient outcomes and reduce mortality rates. In this paper, we propose a real-time ECG and pulse monitoring system that uses proposed system. The system employs an ECG sensor and a pulse sensor that is attached to the patient's chest to collect ECG signals and pulse data, which are read and visualized. The ECG data is also stored in a CSV file which can be used to get the past ECG data. The proposed CNN model is a deep learning algorithm that can detect abnormalities in ECG signals and classify them into six different categories. The model is trained on 22167 images of preclassified ECG signals on the IBM Watson cloud platform and deployed. A GUI has been created using flask to enable users to conveniently upload ECG signals, obtain a classification of their heart condition, and monitor their heart health in a convenient and accessible manner. This can contribute to early detection and treatment of heart conditions, potentially improving patient outcomes.

articleTitle: An AI-Enabled Smart Healthcare Application for Remote Patient Monitoring System
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Recent Trends in Microelectronics, Automation, Computing and Communications Systems (ICMACC)
abstract: This research presents a groundbreaking healthcare application aimed at revolutionizing patient care and improving the overall healthcare experience. The application is developed through an extensive research and development process that leverages cutting-edge technologies to address critical challenges faced by healthcare providers and patients alike. By seamlessly integrating advanced features and functionalities, this application holds the potential to revolutionise the way healthcare is given and received. This, outlines a health care application that aims to improve patient care, facilitate interaction between the healthcare professionals and patients and enhance overall healthcare management. The application provides a comprehensive platform for patients, doctors and healthcare providers to access and manage medical records, schedule appointments, receive personalized health recommendations, and securely communicate in real-time. It incorporates advanced features such as AI-powered symptom analysis, medication reminders, and telemedicine capabilities. The application's user-friendly interface, combined with robust data privacy and security measures, ensures a seamless and confidential healthcare experience for all users. By leveraging technology, this health care application strives to revolutionize the way healthcare is delivered and accessed, ultimately improving patient outcomes and healthcare efficiency.

articleTitle: Machine Learning Approach for Automatic Weld Defect Detection Using Radiographic Images
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Recent Trends in Microelectronics, Automation, Computing and Communications Systems (ICMACC)
abstract: Radiographic images of weld beads are important to inspect subsurface weld defects for safety assurance. The diversified problems associated with the human analysis of radiographic images of the weldments paved the way to the use of machine learning approach for the detection of subsurface defects. Automatic weld defect inspection involves image pre-processing, defect detection, and classification of defects. The techniques of digitization of radiographs, image pre-processing, defect segmentation and classification are summarized. Advanced methods for radiographic weld defect image classification using machine learning and challenges associated with the current technology are discussed for future improvement.

articleTitle: Challenges Associated with 3D Printing of Continuous Fiber Composites
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Recent Trends in Microelectronics, Automation, Computing and Communications Systems (ICMACC)
abstract: The development of 3D printing has transformed the manufacturing processes by enabling intricate and customized part production with high precision. Continuous fiber composites, known for their superior mechanical properties, have become crucial for high-performance aerospace, automotive, and defense applications. This paper explores the challenges in 3D printing these composites using the Markforged Mark Two printer with Onyx matrix. Key issues include void formation, anisotropic behavior, and limitations in slicing software for accurate modeling. Practical difficulties such as warping, misalignment, improper bed leveling, and material defects are analyzed. The study also examines the constraints of proprietary materials and the challenges in vertical fiber reinforcement and narrow-dimension fiber placement. Critical components of the 3D printer, such as the fiber Bowden tube and nozzle heads, are evaluated for their impact on the process and maintenance. This comprehensive analysis aims to propose solutions to these technological obstacles, contributing to optimizing continuous fiber composites in additive manufacturing and highlighting the need for ongoing innovation and research in this field.

articleTitle: Exploring the Impact of Learning Management System (LMS) Adoption on Online Learning: An Educator-Centric Perspective
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Recent Trends in Microelectronics, Automation, Computing and Communications Systems (ICMACC)
abstract: Learning Management Systems (LMS) are used in the context of online learning and it has to be significant from the perspective of educators. It is crucial to comprehend how LMS adoption affects teaching methods, instructional strategies, and overall learning experiences as technology continues to transform educational environments. Utilizing a qualitative research approach, the study collects data from instructors who are actively involved in online learning through surveys and Think aloud observations. The primary objective of this research is to unravel the multifaceted implications of LMS adoption on the teaching profession. The paper addresses several key aspects, including the integration of LMS into pedagogical strategies, changes in teaching methodologies, and the perceived effectiveness of LMS in facilitating student engagement and comprehension. Special attention is given to the challenges and opportunities that emerge for educators as they navigate the complexities of incorporating LMS into their teaching repertoire. The findings of this study contribute to the existing body of knowledge by shedding light on the nuances of LMS adoption from a teacher-centric perspective. Common themes and patterns in teachers’ experiences with LMS, such as the impact on workload, professional development needs, and the role of LMS in fostering collaborative learning environments is identified. Moreover, the alignment between teachers’ expectations and the actual outcomes of LMS integration, offering insights into areas that may require further refinement or support is being done.

articleTitle: Transformer-Enhanced MRI Analysis for Brain Tumor Detection with Kernel-Based PCA and Support Vector Techniques
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Recent Trends in Microelectronics, Automation, Computing and Communications Systems (ICMACC)
abstract: This paper presents a novel approach for brain tumor detection by integrating Transformer-based architectures with Kernel-based Principal Component Analysis (KPCA) and Support Vector Machines (SVM). We used vision transformer model that extracts patch wise features at a dimension 768 features from MRI scans, capturing intricate spatial and temporal patterns associated with brain tumors. These features are then processed using KPCA to address non-linearities and enhance discriminative power. After this SVM classifier is employed to accurately differentiate between tumor and non-tumor tissues. Our experimental results demonstrate significant improvements in classification with an accuracy of 0.91, we also compared with prescribed models. And analyzed the results accuracy and robustness compared to conventional methods, and also provides the interpretation.

articleTitle: Impact of Professional Societies on Enhancement of CO-PO Attainment
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Recent Trends in Microelectronics, Automation, Computing and Communications Systems (ICMACC)
abstract: Outcome based education is an educational framework centred on the explicit achievement of specific learning outcomes. Compared to traditional educational models, OBE entails establishing quantifiable, explicit goals that direct instructional methodologies, curriculum design and assessment technologies. To make sure that students meet the required competencies, evaluations in OBE are tightly matched with learning objectives. Assessment techniques are critical to determining if students in outcome-based education (OBE) have met the required learning objectives. Firstly, direct assessment, in which student achievement is evaluated with actual, observable evidence. For example, Exams, Quizzes, Assignments, Projects, Presentations, Performances, Capstone Projects and Portfolios so on. Secondly, Indirect Assessment, information is gathered that represents how students view their education or how other stakeholders view the skills of their pupils. It offers information about students' experiences and learning environment rather than measuring learning directly. examples are Surveys, Questionnaires, Course Evaluations, Focus Groups and Interviews, Graduate Follow-Up Studies. Direct assessment measures actual student performance, while indirect assessment measures perceptions or reflections on student performance. Both methods are valuable in OBE, with direct assessment providing the most robust evidence of student learning and indirect assessment offering complementary insights that can inform improvements in teaching and learning. This paper introduces the Involvement in Professional bodies like IEEE (Institute of Electrical and Electronics Engineers) and IETE (Institution of Electronics and Telecommunication Engineers), as well as student participation in professional activities associated with these organizations, generally falls under direct assessment in Outcome-Based Education (OBE).this results in increase of CO-PO correlation. The results demonstrated that Co attainment is increased from 2.3 to 2.87 Po attainment is increased from 2.58 to 2.69.

articleTitle: Optimizing Agricultural Productivity: Developing a Smart Crop Recommendation System Using Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Recent Trends in Microelectronics, Automation, Computing and Communications Systems (ICMACC)
abstract: Crop recommendation is the crucial aspect of modern agriculture, aiming to assist farmers in selecting the most suitable crops for their land and maximizing yield. In this study, the effectiveness of various preprocessing techniques, grid search optimization and the pipeline class are applied in conjunction with the different machine learning algorithm for the crop recommendation. The accuracy and efficiency of the recommendation process enhancement is aimed by applying techniques including data standardization, relative density normalization, and grid search optimization. Leveraging Machine Learning algorithms within a unified pipeline framework allows for systematic evaluation and comparison of models, ultimately providing farmers with reliable recommendations for crop selection. Machine Learning algorithms Decision Tree, K-Nearest Neighbor, Random Forest, Support Vector Machine, Logistic Regression and Naïve Bayes were applied to predict and optimize agricultural productivity based on the dataset collected from Nagaland state. Among these algorithms, Random Forest outperformed the others, achieving an impressive accuracy of 99.54% in predicting agricultural productivity.

articleTitle: Revolutionizing Healthcare Diagnostics: Precision and Timeliness Through AI and ML Integration
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Recent Trends in Microelectronics, Automation, Computing and Communications Systems (ICMACC)
abstract: An extensive summary of the revolutionary potential of artificial intelligence (AI) in healthcare is provided in this review article. The research emphasizes the enormous potential of AI to improve patient care and quality of life through a detailed examination of the current level of AI in clinical practice, including disease diagnosis, treatment recommendations, and patient participation. Artificial intelligence (AI) outperforms humans in a number of healthcare domains by utilizing massive datasets and seeing patterns. These benefits include improved accuracy, lower expenses, faster turnaround times, and fewer mistakes. Personalized medicine, better population health management, and optimized treatment plans are among potential benefits of integrating AI into healthcare. To use AI in healthcare responsibly and effectively, however, issues like bias, data protection, and the requirement for human knowledge must be resolved. Continued collaboration between healthcare professionals, technologists, policymakers, and ethicists is essential to maximize the potential benefits of AI while mitigating potential risks

articleTitle: MyoLA: Classifying Myocardial Infarction Based on Transcription Texts Leveraging AI and Linguistic Algorithms
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Recent Trends in Microelectronics, Automation, Computing and Communications Systems (ICMACC)
abstract: Myocardial infarction (MI), also known as heart attack, occurs when blood flow to the heart is obstructed, causing damage to the heart muscle. Diagnosing MI remains challenging due to variable symptoms, inconsistent data, incomplete patient records, and analysis of clinical information like test symptoms, reports, and analysis is challenging for medical professionals. To address these challenges, we introduce MyoLA, a novel framework that combines Linguistic Algorithms (LA) with AI techniques for MI classification from medical transcriptions. MyoLA integrates natural language processing (NLP), principal component analysis (PCA), logistic regression (LR), and random forest models to enhance real-time MI detection and diagnostic accuracy. Utilized a diverse dataset from mtsamples.com, consisting of transcriptions from various medical specialties. The preprocessing pipeline involved text cleaning, lemmatization, and TF-IDF for feature extraction, while class imbalance was handled using the SMOTETomek technique. Dimensionality reduction was achieved through t-distributed stochastic neighbor embedding (t-SNE). Multiple models, including transformer-based models like BERT, were evaluated. Logistic Regression with SMOTETomek yielded an F1-score of 0.94, while BERT achieved superior performance with an F1-score of 0.91 and an accuracy of 98.2%, albeit with higher computational costs. Visualization through confusion matrices and t-SNE plots demonstrated significant improvements in classification accuracy. These findings confirm the potential of integrating advanced NLP techniques and AI models to improve the accuracy and efficiency of MI diagnosis from medical transcriptions.

articleTitle: Development of Digital Currency Using Distributed Ledger
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Recent Trends in Microelectronics, Automation, Computing and Communications Systems (ICMACC)
abstract: This paper proposes a design pattern for implementing Commercial Bank Digital Currency which consists of two main layers – distribution and user constructed on top of a permissioned blockchain network based on Hyperledger. Essentially, distribution part deals with the central banks sending digital currency to commercial banks, while user layer enables the provision of digital currency services to the general audience via commercial banks. A system's design based on Hyperledger blockchain a solution that allows modularity and adjustability of its components, as well as a system model and its operations, and scalability and lists of a variety of benefits such as more transparency, increased operation efficiency, and improved adherence to regulations. The outcomes of the study can be used to get insights into the possible design patterns and effects of using CBDC powered by the Hyperledger.

articleTitle: Gamification: An Emerging Educational Technology for Student Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Recent Trends in Microelectronics, Automation, Computing and Communications Systems (ICMACC)
abstract: Gamification in education is an excellent technique to make students more engaged and motivated in their studies. By incorporating games into the learning process, students can have fun while they learn and develop new skills. There are many ways to gamify education, and each classroom can find the right approach for them. Gamification has become a potential strategy to improve educational environments across the board. This study looks into how motivation and engagement affect learning outcomes when gamification is incorporated into the teaching and learning process. The present study focused on students of higher education engaged in learning language from a game. It analyzed the relationship between student engagement, Motivation for learning, skills for learning, and learning through gamification with the help of data that was collected on a standardized questionnaire from 256 students. The study evaluates how different gamification components, such as points, badges, and leader-boards, affect student motivation and engagement levels. The impact of motivation and engagement was evident on the learning of students. The results suggested that all independent variables have a strong affirmative relationship with learning through gamification as the dependent variable. By highlighting the crucial roles motivation and engagement play in improving learning outcomes, the study report enhances the increasing body of familiarity with the incorporation of gamification in education. For educators, instructional designers, and policymakers interested in using the potential of gamification to develop more efficient and interesting learning environments in the twenty-first century, the findings have practical ramifications.

articleTitle: Digital Image Tamper-Forgery Detection in Security
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Recent Trends in Microelectronics, Automation, Computing and Communications Systems (ICMACC)
abstract: Any industry that employs digital photos has concerns about image security. Images from the crime scene, biometric pictures, suspect photos, and other sources have historically been used by public safety and forensics. The application of digital photographs in this discipline has significantly increased since the advent of digital imaging. Digital image processing has made it easier to alter photos while also inspiring the development of various new forensic investigation techniques. The public's easy access to several snipping and image altering applications raises questions about the veracity of digital pictures. It is used as documentation for a variety of reasons and provides strong evidence in a wide range of crimes. As picture modification and editing tools have advanced, so too have the methods for generating and editing photos. The two most popular techniques for photo counterfeiting are image splicing and copy-and-move forgeries. To conceal or display an incorrect scenario, an image can be spliced, or merged from two photos. It is possible to copy and paste a portion of one image into another. This study looks at the various types of digital image frauds and the tools used to identify them. The techniques currently in use for identifying fake images were examined.

articleTitle: Hate Speech Detection in Telugu Language Using Transformer Models and Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Recent Trends in Microelectronics, Automation, Computing and Communications Systems (ICMACC)
abstract: Hate speech in the social media raises a fundamental concern of social integration and quality individual life. This paper aims at presenting the key importance of hate speech detection in the Telugu language which is a Dravidian language and officially used in the Indian states. Through the use of various transformer models such as BERT, DistilBERT, indicBERT, LaBSE, and MuRIL, the proposed solution offers acceptable accuracy, especially with the MuRIL imprinting an Fl-score of 0.79. The combination of ensemble embedding with machine learning classifiers escalates the performance and exhibits a better position to advance content moderation for only languages in the mainstream multilingual online platforms. This research not only addresses a relevant problem but also helps demonstrate the possibilities of using NLP developments to deal with online hate speech, thus creating less dangerous digital landscapes. The results also underscore the need to maintain the development process and update the further strategies to identify the hate speech persistently due to new tendencies in the interaction within social media platforms.

articleTitle: Smart IoT-Based Emotion Sensing Wearable: Revolutionizing Emotional Well-Being
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Recent Trends in Microelectronics, Automation, Computing and Communications Systems (ICMACC)
abstract: In the fast-paced world of today, mental health has become a critical issue, with emotional stability being a key component of general health. Traditional methods of detecting and managing emotions often fall short due to their reliance on verbal and facial cues, leaving individuals with conditions such as Alexithymia or Autism Spectrum Disorder (ASD) at a disadvantage. This paper introduces a novel solution: the Smart IoT-Based Emotion Sensing Wearable, is designed to revolutionize emotional sensing and management. The primary goal of the research is to create a wearable gadget that can track vital signs and instantly identify different emotions. Using the Internet of Things (IoT), machine learning, and cloud computing, this wearable device bridges the gap for people with special needs and improves emotional understanding for all users by providing real-time emotion recognition and targeted help.

articleTitle: Hybrid Reduced Switch Count (RSC) MLI with Stacked Hexagonal Switched Cell (HSC)
