publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Recent Trends in Microelectronics, Automation, Computing and Communications Systems (ICMACC)
abstract: This paper proposes a novel reduced switch count (RSC) multilevel inverter (MLI) with stacked Hexagonal switched cell (HSC) and a chopper cell. Among the reported, T-type offers much simplified structure, however suffers with key challenges of absence of redundancies and lack of asymmetrical ability. To address the challenges, extended T-type topologies such as Hybrid T-type (HT-type) configurations are reported. Most of the HT-type configurations reported, imposes the concept of six-switch based Hexagonal switched cell (HSC) rather than, conventional four-switch based H-bridge structure. Though, HT-type claims to address the limitations of T-type, scaling of HT-Type to higher level is quite challenging, due to the increase in bidirectional switches and, split dc-link arrangement on both sides of HSC. To resolve the issue, this paper proposes a novel RSC-MLI imposing the concept of stacked HSC. The superiority of the proposed configuration in terms of effective reduction in switch count, presence of redundancies and acceptable standing voltage is demonstrated for symmetrical and asymmetrical (binary and trinary) dc voltage ratios. Further, its easiness in control and implementation is tested using popular reduced carrier based PWM. Finally, output performance of the proposed configuration obtained on MATLAB Simulation is validated on real time environment using opal RT.

articleTitle: Smart Landslide Prevention: Advanced IoT Monitoring and Early Alert System
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Recent Trends in Microelectronics, Automation, Computing and Communications Systems (ICMACC)
abstract: Landslides, or landslips, typically occur on downward slopes and are particularly prevalent in Asian countries. A landslide involves the movement of earth, rock, or other materials down a slope. During the monsoon season, rainwater seeps into the ground and increases hydraulic pressure beyond the soil or rocks' elastic limit. This pressure buildup causes stress, leading to a loss of cohesion among the soil and rocks, ultimately resulting in a landslide. Landslides cause significant damage, destroying agricultural and forested areas, roadways, and ecosystems. The term “mass wasting” is often used to describe any gravity-induced downward movement of soil and rock. Landslides cause property damage, injuries, and fatalities, and they have long-term negative impacts on resources such as water supply, fisheries, sewage systems, dams, and roads. A slope's stability can be influenced by multiple factors acting alone or in combination. Recent surveys indicate that 64.15% of deaths from natural disasters are due to landslides, a major concern. The current prediction systems are often time-consuming and unreliable, leading to increased fatalities. To mitigate these severe effects, it is crucial to predict landslides efficiently and accurately. Human activities like deforestation, agriculture, machinery vibrations, blasting, and mining can decrease shear stress and increase shear strain, affecting slope stability. To reduce the damage caused by landslides, monitoring and early warning systems are essential. One proposed solution is a low-cost, effective loT-based landslide monitoring and alerting system. This system uses ESP32, a gyro sensor, soil moisture sensors, and a vibration sensor. Data collected by Arduino is uploaded to the cloud platform ThingSpeak, allowing real-time monitoring and alerting users via SMS when a landslide is detected.

articleTitle: Effects of Build Orientations on Static Structural Performance in Additive Manufactured Below-Knee Prosthetic Sockets
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Recent Trends in Microelectronics, Automation, Computing and Communications Systems (ICMACC)
abstract: Transtibial (below-knee) prosthetic sockets are essential for restoring mobility and functionality in amputees, as they provide essential support, comfort, and efficient load transfer. Recent advancements have significantly improved the customization, structural integrity, and fit of these sockets in additive manufacturing (AM). This research investigates the impact of various build orientations on the mechanical properties of transtibial prosthetic sockets that are fabricated from thermoplastic Acrylonitrile Butadiene Styrene (ABS) material. Tensile tests were performed on specimens fabricated using fused deposition modeling (FDM) technology as per the ASTM D638 standards. The study assessed transversely isotropic material properties for each orientation, including Young's modulus, shear modulus, and Poisson's ratio. The stiffness varied significantly, with the highest stiffness at 90° and the lowest at 0° orientation. Prosthetic sockets were evaluated under realistic conditions using an experimental test setup, which ensured precise alignment and accurate loading simulation. ANSYS software was employed to conduct numerical simulations to assess stress in sockets of varying thicknesses. The results showed that sockets oriented at 90° exhibited the least von Mises stresses, indicating improved structural strength compared to other build orientations. Experimental validation corroborated these findings, as a 4 mm thick socket failed at the corner of the lobe, closely matching the numerical simulation results with a minimal error of 2.45%.

articleTitle: Determination of Brain Tumors with Neural Networks and CT Scan Imagery
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Recent Trends in Microelectronics, Automation, Computing and Communications Systems (ICMACC)
abstract: The process of brain tumor detection is paramount in the field of medical diagnostics. Early iden- tification of a brain tumor significantly enhances the chances of a patient restoring from it. In recent years, Artificial Intel- ligence has emerged as a promising tool that has efficiently assisted brain tumor detection. This research paper intro-duces an Artificial Intelligence system specifically designed to detect brain tumors based on medical imaging data, like Computed Tomography scans. It is harnessing the power of advanced machine learning algorithms, including deep learning and accuracy of brain tumor detection, facilitating timely medical action and proper treatment planning for patients. We have taken models Support Vector Machine (SVM), Radial Basis Function Neural Network (RBFNN), and Back Propagation Neural Network (BPNN) to train on the Computed Tomography images of the brain collected from the Kaggle and achieved an accuracy of 88.88% using RBFNN and BPNN models.

articleTitle: Intelligent Edge-Based System for Driver Drowsiness Monitoring in Mobile Crowd-sourcing Environments
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Recent Trends in Microelectronics, Automation, Computing and Communications Systems (ICMACC)
abstract: Using CNN and GAN improves road safety, says study. Modern machine learning techniques for mobile crowdsourcing may identify driver fatigue early. Our convolutional neural network (CNN) model detects drivers' fatigue using facial expressions, head movements, and other visual clues. Mobile devices and high-resolution cameras make the system straightforward to install in automobiles. GAN (Generative Advisal Network) handles unequal and limited training data. Creating realistic, synthetic weary driver photos improves the dataset and helps CNN learn from different driving scenarios and face features. Our edge-based computing distinguishes it. In mobile crowdsourcing with unpredictable internet connections, processing data locally on users' smartphones minimizes latency and bandwidth. The edge-based solution processes sensitive data locally on the device rather than sending it to servers, increasing user privacy. Extensive testing showed our system diagnosed driver weariness better than others. GAN-generated data increased model performance in under-represented training datasets. The study shows how to merge CNN and GAN in edge computing with 98.4% accuracy and driver fatigue monitoring. We found important implications for mobile crowdsourcing and intelligent transportation system development.

articleTitle: Water Quality Monitoring and Prediction Using IOT and Analytics
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Recent Trends in Microelectronics, Automation, Computing and Communications Systems (ICMACC)
abstract: Water is indispensable resource. Due to increased industrialization, urbanization water consumption is increasing day by day. At the same time global warming and adverse environment effects are posing challenges on the water as natural resource in terms of its availability and quality. It has become necessary to detect and continuously monitor water pollutants and toxins for its drinking and agriculture purposes. Technological advancements like sensors, internet of things and machine learning techniques are useful in water quality monitoring and prediction. The present paper proposes a cost effective method of calculating Water Quality Index using sensors, microcontroller and a cloud database. Based on the historical data, the web application was capable of predicting the Water quality.

articleTitle: Newspaper Reading in Kannada and English for the Visually Impaired Using Raspberry Pi
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Recent Trends in Microelectronics, Automation, Computing and Communications Systems (ICMACC)
abstract: Newspapers serve as a window to the outside world and provide information regarding current affairs, social reforms, arts and culture. This is the most critical tool used for obtaining information and gaining knowledge must be available equally to everyone including the visually impaired too. If they get good access to newspapers, they will no longer be embarrassed of not knowing and being underinformed about the news around them. But in today's scenario the visually impaired individuals face a mountain of challenges in accessing printed material. Despite a lot of advancement in digital media, the inability to read them makes the visually impaired a little kept away from the full breadth of information available to all sighted individuals. This paper aims to address this issue by developing a portable, cost-effective and a system which reads aloud making news accessible to all. This system serves as an assistive technology for the visually impaired by integrating image processing, machine learning, optical character recognition (OCR) modules and text to speech (TTS) with user interaction supporting English and Kannada languages. By combining these technologies, the system enhances the overall experience and thus this will serve the visually impaired which will significantly improve the quality of their life.

articleTitle: Operator Authentication Using Multi-Level Methods for Standalone Systems
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Recent Trends in Microelectronics, Automation, Computing and Communications Systems (ICMACC)
abstract: In the contemporary digital era, ensuring the security of standalone systems is paramount, especially in scenarios involving sensitive data and critical operations. Traditional authentication methods often fail to provide the necessary security layers to thwart unauthorized access, necessitating a more robust and multifaceted approach to operator authentication. This paper presents an innovative Operator Authentication System (OAS) designed to enhance standalone systems' security by integrating multilevel authentication methods, including encryption and Radio Frequency Identification (RFID). The proliferation of standalone systems in critical infrastructure and sensitive data handling scenarios necessitates an unyielding focus on security measures that can thwart sophisticated cyber threats. This Operator Authentication System (OAS) addresses the current security challenges and anticipates the evolving landscape of cyber threats through its adaptable and forward-thinking design.

articleTitle: Optimization of Data Rates in Channel Varying Mobile Ad-Hoc Networks: A Case Study
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Recent Trends in Microelectronics, Automation, Computing and Communications Systems (ICMACC)
abstract: Optimizing data rates in mobile ad hoc networks (MANETs) is critical for ensuring robust network performance. This research focuses on leveraging the IEEE 802.11g standard's rate control feature, particularly considering a typical mobile ad-hoc network with moderate speed. The inherent dynamic nature of MANETs, characterized by fluctuating topologies and channel conditions, presents challenges in maintaining efficient data transmission rates. Our study contrasts two scenarios: one with the rate control feature enabled and another without it. In the rate control-enabled scenario, data rates are dynamically adjusted based on real-time channel conditions and node mobility, resulting in significant improvements in key network performance parameters, including throughput, packet delivery ratio and end-to-end delay. These improvements are evident across various node speeds. Conversely, the non-rate control scenario, with static data rates, fails to adapt to changing conditions, leading to suboptimal performance across these metrics. Simulation results demonstrate the superiority of the rate control-enabled approach, showing enhanced throughput, higher packet delivery ratios, and lower end-to-end delay. These findings highlight the critical importance of incorporating adaptive rate control mechanisms to achieve optimal data rates and maintain network performance in dynamic wireless environments with varying node speeds. An application use case for this research is in disaster recovery operations, where first responders rely on MANETs for real-time communication and coordination in environments with varying mobility and unpredictable network conditions.

articleTitle: Personalized Healthcare in the IoT Era: Opportunities and Challenges for Implementation
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Recent Trends in Microelectronics, Automation, Computing and Communications Systems (ICMACC)
abstract: By the implementation of the Internet of Things (IoT) in healthcare systems appears to be a promising paradigm change, with the potential to transform patient treatment, patient health management and patient health outcomes. This examines the possibilities, problems, and execution of IoT devices and provides outstanding chances for real-time monitoring, patient health supervision, and immediate decision-making. Healthcare providers can collect continuously patient data streams using connected devices like wearables and sensors. It allows for more Personalized treatment plans and allows easy identification of health problems, reduced hospital costs, and enhanced overall patient health. IoT devices present significant challenges including data protection, security vulnerabilities, and intercommunication barriers that impede widespread adoption. Moreover, integrating IoT devices into existing healthcare infrastructure requires careful attention to regulatory compliance, ethical guidelines, and liability concerns. Healthcare systems may become more efficient, patient-centered, and accessible by safely and innovatively utilizing IoT technologies. Collaboration among health professionals, tech developers, policymakers, and politicians is essential for overcoming issues and reaching IoT's full promise for revolutionizing healthcare delivery and enhancing patient well-being.

articleTitle: IoT-Based Earthworm Cultivation System for Enhanced Soil Fertility and Sustainable Agriculture
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Recent Trends in Microelectronics, Automation, Computing and Communications Systems (ICMACC)
abstract: Earthworms play a crucial role in maintaining the fertility of soil. They help cycle nutrients and break down organic waste, making them indispensable for sustainable farming practices. To harness their benefits effectively. However, ensuring optimal conditions for earthworms growth and reproduction can be a complex task. This paper introduces an innovative IoT-based Earthworm Cultivation System, designed to address this challenge and enhance agricultural sustainability and productivity. The proposed system optimizes earthworm growth and its reproduction. The optimal temperature and humidity for earthworm sustainability are 15–25 degrees Celsius and 60–70% humidity. The proposed model is to automate the monitoring and control of key environmental parameters within earthworm beds. The temperature and humidity sensors are deployed to collect real-time data on critical factors such as temperature and humidity. This data is then processed in IOT board. The central control unit processes the incoming information and based on predefined thresholds, automatically adjusts the temperature using ceramic heat emitter and humidity using ultrasonic humidifier. environmental conditions within the earthworm growth chamber.

articleTitle: Autonomous Number Plate Detection System for Vehicle Identification and Tracking
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Recent Trends in Microelectronics, Automation, Computing and Communications Systems (ICMACC)
abstract: The autonomous number plate detection system plays a crucial role in modern transportation, law enforcement, and security infrastructure. Technical approaches using artificial intelligence, machine learning, and computer vision are actively researched to achieve ease of maintenance through real-time vehicle detection. The recent development has drastically improved the accuracy of object detection and recognition systems in deep neural networks. Using these techniques, vehicle number plates can easily be detected autonomously for vehicle identification and tracking. Here, we have used a custom-trained TensorFlow-based number plate detection method to autonomously detect vehicles using images captured by a smartphone, or surveillance camera. It showed an impressive mAP @ 0.5 of 95%, and demonstrated limitations in long-distance detection, leading us to designate it as the optimal vehicle detection model for accuracy. We designed and developed an autonomous number plate detection system for vehicle identification and tracking, which includes web-based, android-based, and embedded-based applications. In addition, we evaluated the proposed autonomous number plate detection system with real-time images and videos. The proposed system achieved real-time vehicle detection and tracking, boasting a commendable 90% detection accuracy.

articleTitle: Sentiment Analysis of Web Media Using Hybrid Model with T5 and GPT-4 Models
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Recent Trends in Microelectronics, Automation, Computing and Communications Systems (ICMACC)
abstract: In recent years, the advent of pre-trained language models such as T5 (Text-To-Text Transfer Transformer) and GPT-4 (Generative Pre-trained Transformer 4) has significantly advanced the field of Natural Language Processing (NLP). In the realm of natural language processing (NLP), sentiment analysis stands out as a crucial task, enabling us to gauge the sentiment or emotion behind textual data. This article presents a project that combines the T5 transformer and GPT-4 models to enhance sentiment analysis of web media, specifically focusing on YouTube video comments. The project encompasses a multi-step approach, starting with data collection from YouTube, performing initial sentiment classification using the T5 model, refining the analysis with GPT-4 for more nuanced insights, and ultimately deploying a user-friendly web interface. The T5 model, known for its versatility in handling various NLP tasks through a unified text-to-text framework, provides a preliminary sentiment classification. This initial sentiment is further validated and refined using GPT-4, which excels in generating contextually aware and detailed responses. The integration of these models offers a robust solution for analyzing user comments, enhancing both the accuracy and depth of sentiment assessment. The final application is a web-based tool that allows users to input YouTube video URLs and receive comprehensive sentiment analysis results. This combined approach demonstrates the effective use of state-of-the-art NLP models to gain valuable insights into public sentiment and viewer reactions, showcasing the potential of advanced language models in web media analysis.

articleTitle: Synthetic Vs Real: A Comparative Study on AI Generated Art for Improved Learning in AI
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Recent Trends in Microelectronics, Automation, Computing and Communications Systems (ICMACC)
abstract: This research offers an in-depth comparison of emotion detection models developed using real-world and synthetic datasets in the field of artificial intelligence and machine learning. The research rigorously analyses model performance, generalization capacities, and robustness in various circumstances to evaluate the use of synthetic data for machine learning applications. We provide thorough empirical research to examine essential issues concerning predictive accuracy, robustness against adversarial inputs, and biases present in synthetic datasets. Our findings indicate a distinct superiority of real-world datasets, which regularly exceed synthetic datasets in accuracy, precision, and practical utility. This result offers significant insights for researchers and practitioners, highlighting the indispensable importance of genuine data in attaining optimal performance and influencing the future of AI-based emotion recognition systems.

articleTitle: Traffic Sign Recognition for Automated Speed Control Using Deep Learning*
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Recent Trends in Microelectronics, Automation, Computing and Communications Systems (ICMACC)
abstract: Today's newest and most popular topic is real-time driverless cars and their applications. To meet the requirements of these systems, complex algorithms must efficiently perform essential tasks. Autonomous driving technology presents one of the biggest challenges in speed control. We present a new method for speed instruction-based motor control that uses Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs) to predict speed limits. CNNs extract crucial information from traffic sign signatures, and the performance of our system relies on its ability to accurately identify and classify objects in images. The Arduino microcontroller uses the output of the CNN to control the speed of the robot chassis. Experimental results, both in simulations and real-world tests, demonstrate the effectiveness of our approach. The proposed model achieves a high accuracy of 96% to 97% and outperforms existing models with a faster recognition time, maintaining the required speed with minimal error. These findings highlight the potential of CNN-based systems in enhancing autonomous driving technology.

articleTitle: AI Music Assist: A Unified Chatbot Solution for Comprehensive Music Data Access in the Industry
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Recent Trends in Microelectronics, Automation, Computing and Communications Systems (ICMACC)
abstract: The AI Assist for the Music Industry project addresses the critical challenge of fragmented and inaccessible music data dispersed across multiple platforms. With a vast amount of information about music artists, albums, and songs available, collecting this data is time-consuming and often incomplete. This project proposes the development of an AI-powered chatbot, deployed within Microsoft Teams, to provide a unified platform for accessing comprehensive music information effortlessly. The methodologies and technologies employed include Azure, Azure Copilot Studio, Python scripts, and GPT. The chatbot leverages data extracted from prominent music sites like Spotify and YouTube Music through APIs and web scraping techniques. Data from music vendors such as Spotify and Universal Music and internal organizational data are collected using precise API calls and web crawling. Spotify's API offers extensive details on albums, tracks, and artists, which are retrieved in JSON format and converted to CSV files using Python's Pandas library. The conversion process involves creating an empty Data Frame of required features, extracting data using the get attribute from Python dictionaries, and storing the data in CSV format. By integrating this chatbot within Microsoft Teams, the project ensures that users across the organization can easily access accurate and comprehensive music data. This innovative solution enhances data retrieval efficiency, accuracy, and accessibility, making it a valuable tool for industry professionals, researchers, and music enthusiasts.

articleTitle: G-Bot: Revealing Government Programs with Smarted Assistance
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Recent Trends in Microelectronics, Automation, Computing and Communications Systems (ICMACC)
abstract: Residents have had trouble getting accurate state program information for years. G-bot's innovative technology employs NLP to link customers to state-level policies and activities to bridge this knowledge gap. G-bot's core NLP module is taught to deliver reliable and trustworthy information to help people make healthy and progressing decisions. G-bot provides real-time, reliable data to promote public awareness, transparency, and involvement in government processes. Users may explore the enormous state program and regulatory information using G-bot's simple interface. G-bot's Flask integration helps users locate vital information. G-bot enhances user-centric apps beyond information retrieval. AI-powered language processing ushers in a new era, letting individuals shape their communities. G-bot uses NER to identify government entities. This tool simplifies identifying organizations, programs, laws, agencies, and people, improving search results and customizing insights for better decision-making.

articleTitle: Smart Crop Recommender System Using Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Recent Trends in Microelectronics, Automation, Computing and Communications Systems (ICMACC)
abstract: Agriculture is key to any country's economic growth. However, meeting food requirements of the present population due to the ever-rising human population, changing climatic conditions, and limited natural resources becomes a difficult problem. Smart agriculture is an innovative way of supporting farming by recommending the best crops to use and solving the current problems in maintaining farming sustainable. The classification machine learning algorithm is used to build the recommendation model. This paper's concept is a method of choosing appropriate crops that results in several favorable outcomes for agriculture and farmers. Since the crop yield can be increased, it will contribute to boosting our country's economy. Crops recommendation system for agriculture is based on various attributes such as crop type, soil composition, weather condition, soil pH and rainfall. The data have taken from the historic data which was collected from soil and water conservation and district agriculture office Nagaland and use supervised machine learning approaches to apply different ML algorithms. The effected of algorithm are measure on a various scale including Accuracy, Precision, Recall and F1-Score. The random forest outperformed in specifying the suitable crop with an impressive accuracy of 92.59%.

articleTitle: Cygnus: A Vision-Based Drone System for Drowning Detection Using IoT
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Recent Trends in Microelectronics, Automation, Computing and Communications Systems (ICMACC)
abstract: With an estimated 236,000 fatalities each year and 7% of injury-related deaths worldwide, drowning is still a major global concern. In light of drone technology, this study presents a drowning detection system that makes use of IoT and AI/ML. Although drowning events can happen to anyone, our strategy concentrates on vision-based techniques because of their inherent benefits, which include their non-intrusive nature and real-time monitoring capabilities. Our focus on vision-based solutions arises from the limitations of traditional wearable systems, which include their dependence on life buoys and insufficient infrastructure. Our technology provides an aerial perspective of drowning incidents through a wireless drone network. By merging RGB and IR vision, it improves detection accuracy across a range of light, weather, and water conditions. We use edge computing to maximize efficiency and deploy machine learning models, particularly Convolutional Neural Networks (CNN), on drone microprocessors to enable real-time drowning detection. Furthermore, we use LoRa to create a Wireless Sensor Network (WSN) to enable better drone cooperation and communication. In summary, this work introduces a drone-based drowning detection system that makes use of IoT and AI/ML. Our solution intends to improve public safety, reduce drowning incidents, and maybe save lives by addressing the shortcomings of current approaches and embracing fresh methodologies.

articleTitle: Enhancing Voice Pathology Detection with Ensemble Stacking and Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Recent Trends in Microelectronics, Automation, Computing and Communications Systems (ICMACC)
abstract: Classification of the voice pathology plays an important role in both medical field as well as speech processing because voice affects communication, interpersonal relations, and mental well-being. This research work aims at adopting a new technique of Machine learning (ML) that will help in the diagnosis of more serious diseases such as hyperfunctional dysphonia, laryngitis, as well as vox senilis for better patient care and management and ultimately help to cut down the costs incurred in patient health care management. Additive White Gaussian Noise (AWGN) and time stretching was applied to introduce variations to the dataset, while the OpenSMILE toolkit was used to extract key acoustic features from the data. Hyperparameters were optimized with the help of the Optuna library. The best performance of the classifiers was obtained using ensemble stacking, where the final Random Forest classifier achieved an accuracy of 91%. This work also revealed that the meta-model is superior to both the Deep neural networks (DNN) and 1D Convolutional neural network (CNN) in terms of accuracy and precision. It also emphasises on the possibility of recognising and treating voice disorders at earlier stages, thus improving quality of life of patient treated with this disorder.

articleTitle: Efficient Cardiovascular Health Monitoring System for Heart Disease Detection Based on Machine Learning Technique
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Recent Trends in Microelectronics, Automation, Computing and Communications Systems (ICMACC)
abstract: Heart diseases are a global leading cause of death, affecting nations universally. Early detection and machine learning assistance can mitigate mortality despite medical complexities. Hence, timely diagnosis is crucial to prevent heart attacks. This study aims to identify a machine-learning method that strikes a balance between computational efficiency and prediction accuracy when it comes to heart disease prognosis. This work proposes a model integrating various methods for effective heart disease prediction. Employing efficient data collection, pre-processing, and transformation, our model uses an ensemble approach that includes Six classification machine learning algorithms- SVM, DT, RF, LR, KNN, ANN, and PCA. The study identifies significant heart disease features, predicting the highest risk through machine learning. Experimental outcomes indicate prediction accuracy obtained by SVM, DT, RF, LR, KNN, ANN, and PCA. as a feature selection process are 91%, 90%, 86%, 91%, 88%, and 91%. Collaboration is vital for enhancing algorithm precision in clinical settings. The application of machine learning to cardiovascular health has the potential to transform continuous management, personalized treatment, and early diagnosis. Robust clinical tools for better patient outcomes and public health are ensured by addressing issues like data privacy and model interpretability and by fostering interdisciplinary collaboration.

articleTitle: A DC-DC Boost Converter with Switching Inductor and Capacitor with High Gain for Solar Microgrid Applications
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Recent Trends in Microelectronics, Automation, Computing and Communications Systems (ICMACC)
abstract: A high-gain DC-DC booster converter using a changing inductor and capacitors is described in this study for usage in solar microgrids. The suggested converter effectively boosts its low-voltage outputs to make photovoltaic (PV) panels more appropriate for integration into microgrids. As a result of performance losses and excessive stress on internal components, traditional boost converters are unable to provide the necessary voltage rise. Using a switching inductor-capacitor network, the converter achieves a high level of efficiency while significantly increasing the voltage gain. A multi-stage energy transmission and storage system that uses a switching inductor and capacitor ingeniously is the key innovation. Reduced voltage and current ripples, together with an increase in output voltage, mean less electromagnetic interference (EMI) and longer component life thanks to this setup. We validate the converter's performance across a variety of load and input scenarios common to solar microgrids by conducting thorough examinations of its functioning via theoretical modeling and simulation studies. Compared to conventional boost converters, the testing results from the prototype demonstrate a considerable voltage gain and a peak efficiency of more than 95%. In addition, the converter consistently performs competently over many different voltage sources and workload situations, demonstrating its durability for real-world solar applications. Consequently, solar microgrids would be far more effective and dependable with the help of the suggested high-gain boost converter, which would increase the consumption of clean energy sources in DGS.

articleTitle: Battery Management System in Electric Vehicle Applications
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Recent Trends in Microelectronics, Automation, Computing and Communications Systems (ICMACC)
abstract: Battery Management System (BMS) leveraging an Adaptive Neuro-Fuzzy Inference System (ANFIS) for optimized charging protocols and balanced State of Charge (SOC) across multiple batteries. Comprehensive simulations and empirical hardware results substantiate the system's efficacy in maintaining uniform SOC and prolonging battery lifespan. The report meticulously delineates the neural network design process, encompassing data acquisition, network training, and the application of backpropagation algorithms, with a particular focus on the utilization of MATLAB's Neural Network Fitting App (nftool). The outcomes accentuate the pivotal role of sophisticated control strategies and neural network methodologies in augmenting battery performance and predictive analytics, particularly within the domains of electric vehicles and renewable energy systems.

articleTitle: Development of a Customizable High Resolution Wearable Display Badge for Dynamic Visual Content
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Recent Trends in Microelectronics, Automation, Computing and Communications Systems (ICMACC)
abstract: This paper outlines the development and design process of a mini customizable display badge, a compact and lightweight wearable device equipped with a high-resolution display capable of presenting text, images, and animations with precision. At the heart of this badge's design is user personalization, allowing individuals to customize display content and animation effects to their preferences. This feature not only enhances individuality but also broadens its functionality, making it adaptable for various applications. Designed for convenience, the badge features a sleek design that seamlessly integrates into everyday attire without adding bulk. Despite its small size, the high-resolution display ensures vivid visuals, ensuring clarity and impact in any environment. Durability is a key consideration in the badge's construction, ensuring it can withstand daily use. This robustness makes it suitable for a range of applications, including employee identification, event registration, gamification initiatives, and personal expression platforms. Additionally, the badge's adaptability enhances workplace security by providing a dynamic means of identification. Furthermore, its incorporation of interactive elements adds an engaging dimension to events, making it valuable for organizers and participants alike. The mini customizable display badge embodies a blend of innovation and practicality, offering a versatile solution that caters to the evolving needs of modern individuals and organizations.

articleTitle: Emotion Recognition Technology: Decoding Facial Expressions
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Recent Trends in Microelectronics, Automation, Computing and Communications Systems (ICMACC)
abstract: Human emotions are pivotal in communication, and their recognition holds significance across various domains like human-computer interaction and mental health monitoring. This paper presents an image-based approach to emotion recognition, particularly focusing on discerning genuine from insincere emotions. The system uses a combination of machine learning (ML) and deep learning (DL) approaches to improve the accuracy and robustness of emotion recognition by utilizing data from several modalities. Utilizing algorithms such as CNN for facial expression recognition enables the system to extract quantifiable features, thereby improving its capability to distinguish between genuine and fake emotions. Evaluation involves testing with diverse datasets and performance metrics, particularly emphasizing the system's efficacy in detecting fake emotions. The proposed system is able to identify overall 80% of the accuracy over the Decision Tree, SVM and CNN models.

articleTitle: Password Recovery of Android Devices
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Recent Trends in Microelectronics, Automation, Computing and Communications Systems (ICMACC)
abstract: Android is the most widely used mobile operating system, with around 2.5 billion active devices. As phones become more innovative and faster, they play an increasingly important role in our lives. So, the security of Android devices is of more significant concern. The lock screen password, which is like PIN, Passwords, and the pattern, which acts as the front door to our devices, is of greater importance when considering security. So, it's essential to have secure and usable lock screen authentication. This paper analyzed different authentication methods and possible attacks using AI/ML techniques on Android authentication. Also, it explored different password-guessing methods used in machine learning techniques, such as RNN, PCFG, and GAN[10] networks. These models use probabilistic methods to guess the next character based on the previous character and also use the training of the data to think of the character of the password.

articleTitle: Development of an Electrically Operated 3D Printed Gripper Prototype for Pick-and-Place Operation on Spherical Objects
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Recent Trends in Microelectronics, Automation, Computing and Communications Systems (ICMACC)
abstract: A gripper's basic capabilities and common operations include grasping, carrying, and depositing objects. Pick and place mechanisms are used in traditional gripper manufacturing; however, they are not ideal for mass working or mass production rates. Traditional manufacturing methods are generally used to design a large number of grippers. However, it needs a lot of time, skills, and people for each individual gripper. 3D printing has opened up opportunities in various sectors. This paper presents development and functional deployment of a gripper prototype using 3D printing technique to overcome the stated challenges. A three fingered gripper capable of grabbing objects like plastic ball is designed in CATIA V5 software based on parameters like finger length, grip force, actuation time, DOF, accuracy and the ability to pick and release. Parts of the gripper are 3D printed on a fused deposition modeling printer and assembled later. Digital servo tester ESC CCPM and MG 996R motor are used to make the gripper prototype functional. Thus, a functional 3D printed prototype of a 3-fingered gripper is successfully demonstrated for grasping circular objects like sponge ball and plastic ball.

articleTitle: Enhancing Telugu Abusive Language Detection Using Word Embeddings and BERT Models
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Recent Trends in Microelectronics, Automation, Computing and Communications Systems (ICMACC)
abstract: In the digital era, the surge of abusive content online underscores the necessity for robust content moderation. This study targets the challenges posed by abusive content in Telugu, a language with limited digital resources. The goal is an advanced framework to classify Telugu sentences as abusive or not, using FastText and IndicFast for word embedding. Various machine learning techniques like Decision Trees, SVM, KNN, Random Forest, RNN, LSTM, BiLSTM, GRU, and transfer learning with pre-trained BERT models are explored. Each method is evaluated for its ability to capture abusive language nuances. The study employs diverse word vector dimensions for comprehensive coverage, systematically evaluating techniques to identify optimal classification combinations. It also investigates transfer learning via pre-trained BERT models, leveraging knowledge from other datasets to enhance Telugu abusive language understanding. This research enriches natural language processing and content moderation knowledge. It offers insights into effective word embedding techniques and ML algorithms for low-resource languages, aiding in the development of sensitive content moderation tools for Telugu speakers, fostering a safer online space.

articleTitle: EEG-Based Emotion Recognition Using Deep Learning Models
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Recent Trends in Microelectronics, Automation, Computing and Communications Systems (ICMACC)
abstract: Emotion recognition is an emerging field of research and modalities like images, videos, speech, text, physiological signals, and EEG are used for the same. In this work, EEG based emotion recognition has been proposed using deep learning models. The recognition of emotion from EEG has attracted a lot of interest and has been applied in numerous fields, particularly in health, technology, and computing. In this work, two methods are proposed for emotion recognition from EEG signals, viz., a signal-based approach and an image conversion approach. the accuracy achieved by the models CNN+GRU, 2D- CNN and LSTM are 96.54%, 90.58%, and 87%, respectively. This work also addresses some of the issues related to model deployment, how to deal with logical and causal relations, and how to implement the outcomes in a real-time environment.

articleTitle: Harnessing Big Data for Price Predictions in Oil and Gas Markets
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Recent Trends in Microelectronics, Automation, Computing and Communications Systems (ICMACC)
abstract: This study aims to construct a robust forecasting model for predicting future prices of oil and gas resources, crucialfor diverse industries. Beginning with an exploration of foundational theories pertinent to oil and gas price forecasting, the research focuses on two pivotal forecast theories: the Target Capacity Utilization Principle (TCU) and the Theory of Exhaustible Resources. Employing a recursive simulation model grounded in the Target Capacity Utilization Rule and leveraging historical data spanning from 1987 to 2017, the study forecasts oil and gas prices from 1991 to 2017. The devised methodology results in a Mean Absolute Deviation (MAD) of 12.676, Mean Squared Error (MSE) of 280.92, Mean Absolute Percentage Error (MAPE) of 0.2597, and Mean Percentage Error (MPE) of 0.028. Furthermore, the analysis is extended to monthly forecasts, yielding a MAD of 5.66, MSE of 82.1163, MAPE of 0.1246, and MPE of 0.038. These outcomes underscore the model's effectiveness, especially at the monthly forecasting level.

articleTitle: Computational Investigation of Intracellular Calcium Waves Within Urinary Bladder Smooth Muscle Cells
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Recent Trends in Microelectronics, Automation, Computing and Communications Systems (ICMACC)
abstract: We present a computational model to investigate intracellular calcium waves within the detrusor smooth muscle (DSM) cells of the urinary bladder. The proposed model integrates models of cell membrane pump and sarcoplasmic reticulum (SR) receptors and pump mechanisms. Our model generates spatio-temporal profiles of the intracellular calcium signal under various conditions regarding the relative positioning of receptors and pumps. Our model is employed to study the roles of the SR receptors in the inception and propagation of intracellular calcium waves in the form of calcium-induced and IP3-induced calcium release mechanisms. We present an innovative application of our model regarding the exploration of spatio-temporal positioning of SR and membrane mechanisms necessary for propagation and termination of calcium waves. We correlate the computational findings of our model with underlying physiology of the DSM cells. This model can serve as a basis to provide enhanced insights into factors governing the origin and spread of calcium signals. Our model is uniquely placed to provide a deeper insight into intracellular calcium signalling within the DSM cells. Further development of the model will provide a firmer foundation to elucidate the transduction of intracellular calcium signals to an equivalent contractile force within the smooth muscle of the bladder.

articleTitle: An Automated Recommendation Model for E-Commerce Web Application Using Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Recent Trends in Microelectronics, Automation, Computing and Communications Systems (ICMACC)
abstract: The rapid evolution of the Internet and technological advancements have revolutionized the retail landscape, giving rise to e-commerce as a dominant force in the industry. In response to the increasing demand for online shopping, businesses are compelled to develop innovative, user-friendly web applications to cater to evolving consumer needs. This abstract introduces an innovative e-commerce web application designed to transform the online shopping experience. Leveraging cutting-edge technologies, intuitive user interfaces, and personalized recommendations, our web application aims to enhance convenience, engagement, and customer satisfaction. Through a comparative analysis, we demonstrate that our solution surpasses existing methods. Our e-commerce web application boasts intuitive search and filtering capabilities, empowering users to easily navigate through a vast product catalogue. Moreover, sophisticated recommendation algorithms, driven by machine learning techniques, provide personalized product suggestions based on users' browsing and purchasing history, significantly enhancing the overall shopping experience. The web application ensures seamless performance, even during peak traffic periods and also offers integrated secure payment gateways for customers confidence and peace of mind while completing transactions. By combining advanced technology with user-centric design, this e-commerce web application sets a new standard for online shopping, promising increased convenience, engagement and satisfaction for users.

articleTitle: An Analysis of the Proof-of-Driving (PoD) Consensus for VANET
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Recent Trends in Microelectronics, Automation, Computing and Communications Systems (ICMACC)
abstract: Vehicular Ad Hoc Networks (VANETs) are the backbone of Intelligent Transportation Systems (ITS), offering an effective way of communication between vehicles and roadside hardware. In such a highly dynamic and decentralized environment, ensuring trust and security has serious challenges. This paper investigates the consensus mechanism Proof-of-Driving (PoD) for VANET. Using real-time driving data, PoD establishes trust among the participating nodes in the network affected, thus providing a robust framework for secure communication. For consensus evaluation, efficiency, scalability, security, and energy consumption are considered key metrics. Further, this research offers a deep comparison concerning how well PoD stands alongside other consensus mechanisms and its design principles. Finally, the possible measures are suggested to enhance consensus mechanisms for VANET.

articleTitle: Speckle Noise Reduction in Intravascular Ultrasound Images Using Hybrid Model
publicationTitle: 2024 2nd International Conference on Recent Trends in Microelectronics, Automation, Computing and Communications Systems (ICMACC)
abstract: Intravascular Ultrasound (IVUS) is a medical imaging technique used to visualize the interior of blood vessels, particularly coronary arteries. Speckle reduction in IVUS images refers to the process of minimizing or removing the “speckle noise” present in these images, which can hinder accurate interpretation and analysis. Speckle noise appears as a granular or grainy texture, often caused by interference patterns in ultrasound imaging. A hybrid de-speckling model based on a neural network and complex wavelet shrinkage and non-local PCA-based filtering is proposed to suppress the noise in ultrasound images. The technique uses Maximum a Posterior (MAP) estimator to perform denoising in the Complex Wavelet (CW) domain in the first stage. The wavelet coefficients of the log-transformed IVUS image are obtained after executing the Undecimated Dual-Tree - Complex Wavelet Transform (UDT-CWT). In the subsequent stage, inverse UDT-CWT and Non-Local Means Principal Component Analysis (NL-PCA) are both used. The neural network-based filter and the proposed technique are compared for analyzing the performance of the filter. Evaluation metrics such as Signal to Noise Ratio (SNR), Peak Signal to Noise Ratio (PSNR), Structural Similarity Index, Beta Metric and Naturalness Image Quality Evaluator (NIQE) are estimated. The experimental findings demonstrated that the CWT-NLPCA improves speckle reduction while maintaining details in homogeneous areas. will demonstrate that the experimented filter is highly competitive regarding one of the most cutting-edge techniques.
